examples.zh: 这部电影讲述了纽约一个黑手党家族的故事。

meaning: a. 过分简单化的

examples.en: His simplistic answer ignored the complex causes of the problem.
examples.zh: 他过于简单化的回答忽略了问题的复杂原因。

meaning: n. 柏油碎石, 柏油碎石路

examples.en: The plane waited on the tarmac before taking off.
examples.zh: 飞机起飞前在停机坪上等候。

meaning: a. 小儿科的;儿科的

examples.en: She works as a nurse in the pediatric ward.
examples.zh: 她在儿科病房当护士。

meaning: n. 丰富, 肥沃;富集

examples.en: The school offers art and music as enrichment programs.
examples.zh: 学校开设艺术和音乐作为拓展课程。

meaning: vt. 在金属外包上另一种金属;a. 包层金属的

examples.en: The old barn was clad in weathered wooden boards.
examples.zh: 旧谷仓的外墙包着风化的木板。

meaning: n. 神, 神性

examples.en: She studied divinity at university before becoming a priest.
examples.zh: 她上大学时攻读神学,后来当了牧师。

meaning: n. 哥伦比亚

examples.en: My cousin studies law at Columbia in New York.
examples.zh: 我表哥在纽约的哥伦比亚大学读法律。

meaning: n. 款式, 式样

examples.en: The new car's styling looks fresh and modern.
examples.zh: 这款新车的造型看起来清新又现代。

meaning: n. 汉堡（德国城市）

examples.en: My uncle lives in Hamburg and works at the port.
examples.zh: 我叔叔住在汉堡,在港口工作。

meaning: n. 格林威治

examples.en: We visited Greenwich and stood on the prime meridian line.
examples.zh: 我们参观了格林威治,站在本初子午线上。

meaning: n. 立体交叉道, 互换;vt. 交换, 互换

examples.en: The conference encouraged an interchange of ideas between students.
examples.zh: 会议鼓励学生们交流思想。

meaning: feed的过去式和过去分词;联邦储备局

examples.en: The farmer fed the horses before sunrise.
examples.zh: 农夫在日出前喂了马。

meaning: a. 位移的；无家可归的；被取代的

examples.en: The war left thousands of families displaced from their homes.
examples.zh: 战争使成千上万的家庭流离失所。

meaning: n. 动员, 调动, 活动法;活动化

examples.en: The flood triggered a huge mobilization of volunteers.
examples.zh: 洪水引发了志愿者的大规模动员。

meaning: vt.vi. 降低...的价值, 贬值, 降低价值, 使(货币)贬值;贬值

examples.en: The government decided to devalue the currency last spring.
examples.zh: 政府决定在去年春天让货币贬值。

meaning: 社会心理的(指社会环境影响下的个人心理变化)

examples.en: The clinic offers psychosocial support for young patients.
examples.zh: 诊所为年轻患者提供心理社会支持。

meaning: n. 剪断, 剪裁, 剪下物, 剪报;a. 第一流的, 头等的, 极好的, 快速的

examples.en: She kept a clipping of the newspaper story about her.
examples.zh: 她留着一张关于她的报纸剪报。

meaning: v. 想( imagine的过去式和过去分词 ); 想像; 料想; 误认为

examples.en: I imagined the beach house would be much larger.
examples.zh: 我原以为那座海滨别墅会大得多。

meaning: n. 输入者, 进口商;进口商, 输入者

examples.en: The country is the largest importer of coffee beans.
examples.zh: 这个国家是最大的咖啡豆进口国。

meaning: 颂歌, 咒语(尤指四吠陀经典内作为咒文或祷告唱念的)

examples.en: Repeat your mantra slowly when you feel stressed.
examples.zh: 感到压力时,就慢慢地重复你的咒语。

meaning: vt. 公布, 为...做广告, 宣传

examples.en: The club used posters to publicise the charity concert.
examples.zh: 俱乐部用海报宣传这场慈善音乐会。

meaning: a. 有斑点的, 斑纹的, 弄污了的

examples.en: A spotted deer stood quietly at the edge of the forest.
examples.zh: 一只梅花鹿安静地站在森林边上。

meaning: a. 煮沸的, (非正式)喝醉的, 烧滚的

examples.en: I had a boiled egg and toast for breakfast.
examples.zh: 我早餐吃了一个煮蛋和吐司。

meaning: n. 护坡(石), 铺地石, 俯仰, (船的)上下颠簸

examples.en: Years of pitching practice made his arm very strong.
examples.zh: 多年的投球训练让他的手臂很强壮。

meaning: a. 不完美的, 不完整的, 减弱的, 未完成过去时的;n. 未完成体

examples.en: My French is imperfect, but I keep practicing every day.
examples.zh: 我的法语不完美,但我每天坚持练习。

meaning: n. 铺筑过的地面, 铺过的道路, 铺筑过的路, 修筑路面/地面的材料

examples.en: The garden path is covered with old stone paving.
examples.zh: 花园的小路铺着旧石板。

meaning: 临床医师, 临证医师

examples.en: The clinician asked about my sleep and eating habits.
examples.zh: 临床医生询问了我的睡眠和饮食习惯。

meaning: vt. 送...进医院治疗;入院

examples.en: Doctors decided to hospitalize grandfather after his fall.
examples.zh: 祖父摔倒后,医生决定让他住院。

meaning: n. 反射, 反射光, 映像;a. 反射的, 折转的

examples.en: Blinking is a reflex that protects your eyes.
examples.zh: 眨眼是保护眼睛的一种反射动作。

meaning: a. 响亮的, 明白的, 清脆的, 干脆的;振铃

examples.en: The ringing phone woke the baby from her nap.
examples.zh: 电话铃把午睡的婴儿吵醒了。

meaning: n. 直布罗陀

examples.en: They sailed past Gibraltar on their way to Spain.
examples.zh: 他们在去西班牙的路上驶过直布罗陀。

meaning: n. 被任命者;被指定的人, 被任命者

examples.en: The new appointee will manage the department starting in May.
examples.zh: 新任命的人将从五月开始管理部门。

meaning: n. 鹭

examples.en: A grey heron stood in the shallow water fishing.
examples.zh: 一只灰鹭站在浅水里捕鱼。

meaning: a. 〈心理〉前摄的

examples.en: Being proactive about repairs saves money in the long run.
examples.zh: 主动检修从长远看能省不少钱。

meaning: n. 连衫衬裤；泰迪玩具熊

examples.en: The little girl never sleeps without her old teddy.
examples.zh: 小女孩没有旧泰迪熊就睡不着觉。

meaning: a. 受污染的；弄脏的

examples.en: The village well was contaminated by factory waste water.
examples.zh: 村里的水井被工厂废水污染了。

meaning: adv. 表示特性地

examples.en: He characteristically arrived early and helped set up chairs.
examples.zh: 他一如既往地早到,帮忙摆椅子。

meaning: n. 垃圾, 肥料;vt. 施肥, 弄脏, 弄糟

examples.en: The farmer spread muck on the fields every spring.
examples.zh: 农夫每年春天都往田里撒粪肥。

meaning: n. 讨厌, 嫌恶

examples.en: She looked at the messy kitchen with clear distaste.
examples.zh: 她带着明显的厌恶看着凌乱的厨房。

meaning: n. 攀登, 爬上;v. 爬上, 攀登

examples.en: We had to clamber over rocks to reach the beach.
examples.zh: 我们不得不翻过岩石才能到海滩。

meaning: adv. 下游地;a. 下游的

examples.en: The paper mill polluted the water for miles downstream.
examples.zh: 造纸厂污染了下游数英里的河水。

meaning: a. 制造的, 已制成的

examples.en: These toys are manufactured in a small factory in Ohio.
examples.zh: 这些玩具由俄亥俄州的一家小工厂制造。

meaning: a. 自动的；机器人的, 像机器人的

examples.en: The factory uses a robotic arm to lift heavy parts.
examples.zh: 工厂用机械臂来吊起沉重的零件。

meaning: n. 所罗门(古以色列国王), 聪明人, 贤人;所罗门阵列处理机

examples.en: King Solomon was famous for his great wisdom.
examples.zh: 所罗门王以非凡的智慧闻名。

meaning: n. 骑自行车/摩托车的人

examples.en: A biker in a leather jacket stopped at the roadside cafe.
examples.zh: 一个穿皮夹克的摩托车手停在路边咖啡馆。

meaning: n. 剑桥郡

examples.en: Her parents run a small farm in Cambridgeshire.
examples.zh: 她父母在剑桥郡经营一家小农场。

meaning: n. 分枝, 分叉, 枝状物, 支脉, 支流, 衍生物;分支, 支状分布

examples.en: Experts debated every ramification of the new tax policy.
examples.zh: 专家们争论新税收政策的每一项影响。

meaning: n. 骑, 乘车, 乘, 骑术, 骑马

examples.en: She goes riding in the countryside every Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 她每周日早上去乡间骑马。

meaning: a. 毁灭的, 没落的, 荒废的

examples.en: They explored the ruined castle above the quiet town.
examples.zh: 他们探访了安静小镇上方的城堡废墟。

meaning: n. 主席的身份或资格

examples.en: Under his chairmanship, the committee doubled its membership.
examples.zh: 在他的主持下,委员会成员翻了一倍。

meaning: n. 婴儿车, 平底船, (送牛奶用的)手推车

examples.en: She pushed the pram slowly along the river path.
examples.zh: 她推着婴儿车沿着河边小路慢慢走。

meaning: n. 斯堪的纳维亚(半岛)

examples.en: They are traveling through Scandinavia by train this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天他们乘火车穿越斯堪的纳维亚。

meaning: n. 警戒, 监视, 守夜;不眠, 警醒

examples.en: The nurses kept a quiet vigil beside the sick man.
examples.zh: 护士们在病人身旁静静守夜。

meaning: n. 正统说法, 正教, 信奉正教

examples.en: The young chef challenged the orthodoxy of French cooking.
examples.zh: 年轻厨师挑战了法餐烹饪的传统观念。

meaning: adv. 不舒适地, 不自在地, 令人不快地

examples.en: The wooden bench was uncomfortably hard after an hour.
examples.zh: 一个小时后,木头长凳硬得让人难受。

meaning: a. 非暴力的

examples.en: The huge march remained completely nonviolent until the end.
examples.zh: 这场大规模游行自始至终完全和平。

meaning: n. 迈阿密

examples.en: We spent spring break in Miami with my cousins.
examples.zh: 我们和表亲们在迈阿密度过了春假。

meaning: n. 曼哈顿

examples.en: Her apartment in Manhattan is small but very expensive.
examples.zh: 她在曼哈顿的公寓很小却很贵。

meaning: 紧张性刺激; 应激物

examples.en: Final exams are the biggest stressor for most students.
examples.zh: 期末考试是大多数学生最大的压力源。

meaning: n. 编辑, 编纂, 编辑(编纂)物;编译

examples.en: The album is a compilation of songs from the nineties.
examples.zh: 这张专辑是九十年代歌曲的合辑。

meaning: a. 一文不名的;break的过去式

examples.en: I can't come out tonight because I'm completely broke.
examples.zh: 我今晚不能出去,因为我完全没钱了。

meaning: n. 费城

examples.en: They visited Philadelphia to see the famous Liberty Bell.
examples.zh: 他们去费城看著名的自由钟。

meaning: n. 捕鸟者

examples.en: In the old tale, a fowler catches birds with a net.
examples.zh: 在古老的故事里,捕鸟人用网捕鸟。

meaning: v. 切碎( mince的过去式和过去分词 ); 剁碎; 绞碎; 用绞肉机绞（食物, 尤指肉）

examples.en: Add the minced garlic to the hot oil and stir well.
examples.zh: 把蒜末倒进热油里,翻炒一下。

meaning: n. 陈列室;样品间, 陈列室

examples.en: The new model stood in the center of the showroom.
examples.zh: 新型号摆在展厅的正中央。

meaning: n. 郡

examples.en: The story is set in a quiet shire in England.
examples.zh: 故事发生在英格兰一个安静的郡。

meaning: n. 判断, 估计, 尊重;估计; 估定; 测定; 估值

examples.en: In my estimation, the repairs will cost about two hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 据我估计,修理费大约要两百美元。

meaning: vi. 叫喊, 发牢骚, 抱怨;vt. 大声叫喊

examples.en: If you need anything, just holler and I will come running.
examples.zh: 需要什么就喊一声,我马上就来。

meaning: n. (美式橄榄球)侧卫

examples.en: The cornerback intercepted the pass and scored a touchdown.
examples.zh: 角卫截下了传球并达阵得分。

meaning: a. 智力上迟钝的

examples.en: The project was retarded by a lack of funds.
examples.zh: 项目因资金不足而进展迟缓。

meaning: n. 现代作风, 现代主义, 现代思想

examples.en: The gallery shows paintings influenced by European modernism.
examples.zh: 美术馆展出受欧洲现代主义影响的画作。

meaning: a. 被指名的, 指定的;命名的, 指定的, 有名的

examples.en: The hospital was named after a famous local doctor.
examples.zh: 这家医院以当地一位名医的名字命名。

meaning: n. 吸毒者, 笨蛋, 麻醉药物, 粘稠物;vt. 麻痹, 上涂料, 预测出

examples.en: Only a dope would leave his keys in the door.
examples.zh: 只有傻瓜才会把钥匙插在门上。

meaning: 斯塔福德郡

examples.en: The antique plates were made in Staffordshire two centuries ago.
examples.zh: 这些古董盘子是两百年前在斯塔福德郡制作的。

meaning: n. 教民

examples.en: The priest greeted every parishioner after the Sunday service.
examples.zh: 牧师在周日礼拜后问候每一位教民。

meaning: n. 布莱叶点字法(盲人用点字法);vt. 用布莱叶点字法印刷

examples.en: She learned braille so she could read books by touch.
examples.zh: 她学会了盲文,能用手摸着读书。

meaning: n. 休斯敦

examples.en: Our flight to Houston leaves early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我们飞往休斯敦的航班明天一早起飞。

meaning: n. 骨质疏松症;骨质疏松; 骨质疏松症

examples.en: Older women are more likely to develop osteoporosis than men.
examples.zh: 老年女性比男性更容易得骨质疏松症。

meaning: n. 马提尼（一种鸡尾酒, 等于Martini）

examples.en: The bartender mixed a martini with a twist of lemon.
examples.zh: 调酒师调了一杯带柠檬片的马提尼。

meaning: n. 划船

examples.en: He joined the university rowing team last autumn.
examples.zh: 他去年秋天加入了大学赛艇队。

meaning: adv. 顺利地, 亲切地, 好意地

examples.en: The judges viewed her performance very favorably.
examples.zh: 评委们对她的表现评价很高。

meaning: a. 冷淡的, 有支架的;n. 冷淡, 平衡, 和局

examples.en: The long standoff between the two companies finally ended in June.
examples.zh: 两家公司之间的长期僵持终于在六月结束。

meaning: n. <旧俚>(赌博中作弊的)假骰

examples.en: Fulham played well but lost the home game.
examples.zh: 富勒姆踢得不错,但输掉了主场比赛。

meaning: a. 着迷的

examples.en: He is obsessive about keeping his desk perfectly tidy.
examples.zh: 他痴迷于保持书桌绝对整洁。

meaning: n. 哥伦比亚人;a. 哥伦比亚的

examples.en: Her Colombian coffee is smooth and slightly sweet.
examples.zh: 她的哥伦比亚咖啡口感顺滑,略带甜味。

meaning: n. 委派, 信托, 鉴定合格;立案, 备案, 任命

examples.en: The business school earned its accreditation last spring.
examples.zh: 这所商学院去年春天获得了资格认证。

meaning: a. 合犹太人戒律的, 清净的, 合适的

examples.en: They bought kosher bread for the holiday dinner.
examples.zh: 他们为节日晚餐买了犹太洁食面包。

meaning: a. 无决断力的, 不果断的, 无决心的, 未解决的, 未澄清的, 未议决的, 未分解的;非分辩的

examples.en: The two neighbors left their dispute unresolved for years.
examples.zh: 这两位邻居的争执多年都没有解决。

meaning: n. 避孕, 避孕法;节(制生)育, 避孕

examples.en: The health clinic gives free advice about contraception.
examples.zh: 健康诊所免费提供避孕方面的建议。

meaning: n. 性别歧视者

examples.en: The company fired him for making sexist jokes at work.
examples.zh: 公司因他在工作中讲性别歧视笑话而开除了他。

meaning: a. 宗派的, 党派的, 偏狭的;n. 宗派成员, 闹宗派的人

examples.en: The charity helps people on both sides of sectarian divides.
examples.zh: 这家慈善机构帮助教派分歧双方的民众。

meaning: n. 女学生

examples.en: The schoolgirl waved to her friends from the bus window.
examples.zh: 女生从公交车车窗向朋友们挥手。

meaning: adv. 感激地

examples.en: He gratefully accepted the warm meal from the volunteers.
examples.zh: 他感激地接过志愿者递来的热饭。

meaning: n. 招徕顾客的人, 剥树皮者;去皮机, 剥皮机

examples.en: A carnival barker invited us to see the magic show.
examples.zh: 游乐场的叫卖员请我们去看魔术表演。

meaning: vt. 使不适合, 取消...资格

examples.en: Using outside help may disqualify you from the contest.
examples.zh: 使用外部帮助可能会取消你的比赛资格。

meaning: 格兰纳达薄呢

examples.en: They toured the old palace in Granada last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天他们参观了格拉纳达的古老宫殿。

meaning: a. 弱的, 虚弱的;adv. 微弱地, 虚弱地

examples.en: The sick man smiled weakly at the nurse.
examples.zh: 病人朝护士虚弱地笑了笑。

meaning: n. 日托；日间照管儿童

examples.en: Both parents work, so the twins go to daycare on weekdays.
examples.zh: 父母都上班,双胞胎工作日去日托。

meaning: n. 驾车, 乘汽车

examples.en: They enjoy motoring along the coast in summer.
examples.zh: 他们喜欢夏天开车沿着海岸兜风。

meaning: n. 诺贝尔

examples.en: She won the Nobel Prize for her work in medicine.
examples.zh: 她因医学方面的成就获得了诺贝尔奖。

meaning: vt. 秘密地除去, 秘密地消灭, 压制

examples.en: The committee tried to burke the report for months.
examples.zh: 委员会试图把这份报告压下好几个月。

meaning: n. 接近, 近似值;接近; 近似

examples.en: This map is only an approximation of the real coastline.
examples.zh: 这张地图只是真实海岸线的近似图。

meaning: adv. 在战略上, 颇策略地

examples.en: The castle was strategically placed on a hill above the river.
examples.zh: 城堡在战略上建于河边的山上。

meaning: n. 股票经纪人

examples.en: Her son works as a stockbroker in London.
examples.zh: 她儿子在伦敦当股票经纪人。

meaning: a. 厚颜的, 无耻的, 色情的

examples.en: The cheeky boy asked for a second piece of cake.
examples.zh: 那个调皮的男孩又要了一块蛋糕。

meaning: n. 节日, 喜庆日, 欢宴, 欢庆

examples.en: The whole town joined the festivity on the final night.
examples.zh: 最后一晚全镇的人都参加了庆祝活动。

meaning: n. 降低速度, 减速

examples.en: The snow caused a big slowdown on the highways this morning.
examples.zh: 今早的雪使高速公路车速大幅放缓。

meaning: n. 啦啦队长

examples.en: My sister is a cheerleader for the college basketball team.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是大学篮球队的啦啦队员。

meaning: n. 下层丛林, 生于大树下的矮树, 发育不全

examples.en: A rabbit darted into the undergrowth beside the trail.
examples.zh: 一只兔子窜进了小路旁的灌木丛。

meaning: 跳伞

examples.en: The government prepared a bailout for the failing car company.
examples.zh: 政府为陷入困境的汽车公司准备了救助资金。

examples.zh: 孩子因为拉肚子待在家没去上学。

meaning: 高尔半岛

examples.en: They camped on the Gower peninsula last August.
examples.zh: 他们去年八月在高尔半岛露营。

meaning: a. 修道院的, 僧尼的, 寺院的, 庙宇的, 禁欲生活的;n. 修道士

examples.en: The monks keep a monastic routine of prayer and silence.
examples.zh: 僧侣们保持着祈祷与静默的修道作息。

meaning: a. 科威特的, 科威特人的;n. 科威特人

examples.en: My Kuwaiti classmate invited us to dinner at his home.
examples.zh: 我的科威特同学请我们去他家吃晚饭。

meaning: 奇切斯特(西苏塞克斯郡首府)

examples.en: They stopped in Chichester to see the old cathedral.
examples.zh: 他们在奇切斯特停留,去看古老的大教堂。

meaning: a. 名誉退休的, 退休后保留头衔的

examples.en: Professor Hale became emeritus after teaching for forty years.
examples.zh: 黑尔教授任教四十年后成为荣誉退休教授。

meaning: n. 取消抵押品赎回权;取消抵押品赎回权的法律手续

examples.en: They lost the house to foreclosure after he lost his job.
examples.zh: 他失业后,房子因止赎被银行收走了。

meaning: a. 不安全的, 不牢靠的, 不坚固的, 不稳定的

examples.en: He felt insecure about his accent at the new school.
examples.zh: 在新学校,他对自己的口音感到不自信。

meaning: n. 嬉皮士

examples.en: My aunt was a hippy who traveled around in a van.
examples.zh: 我姑姑是个开着房车四处旅行的嬉皮士。

meaning: n. 科罗拉多, 科罗拉多河

examples.en: They went skiing in Colorado every winter for years.
examples.zh: 多年来他们每年冬天都去科罗拉多滑雪。

meaning: n. 数学家

examples.en: The mathematician spent years proving the famous theorem.
examples.zh: 这位数学家花了多年证明那个著名定理。

meaning: a. 超现实主义的；离奇的；不真实的

examples.en: Walking through the deserted city felt completely surreal.
examples.zh: 走过空无一人的城市,感觉完全不真实。

meaning: n. 证实, 查证, 证明属实;验证

examples.en: The bank requires identity verification before opening your account.
examples.zh: 银行要求先完成身份验证才能开户。

meaning: n. 大麻;大麻

examples.en: Several states now allow cannabis for medical use.
examples.zh: 现在有几个州允许将大麻用于医疗。

meaning: a. 传记的

examples.en: She wrote a biographical novel about the explorer's life.
examples.zh: 她写了一部关于那位探险家生平的传记小说。

meaning: a. 被收养的, 被采用的

examples.en: Their adopted daughter quickly became part of the family.
examples.zh: 他们收养的女儿很快就融入了这个家。

meaning: n. 子爵

examples.en: The viscount invited us to his country house for tea.
examples.zh: 子爵邀请我们去他的乡间别墅喝茶。

meaning: n. 洗液;洗剂

examples.en: Put on some sun lotion before you go to the beach.
examples.zh: 去海边之前先涂点防晒乳液。

meaning: n. 桩, 尖桩, 警戒哨, 巡逻艇, 纠察队;vt. 围住, 警戒, 派...担任纠察

examples.en: A picket stood at the factory gate with a sign.
examples.zh: 一名纠察队员举着牌子站在工厂门口。

meaning: n. 框架, 干部;干部

examples.en: The company trained a cadre of new managers last year.
examples.zh: 公司去年培训了一批新经理骨干。

meaning: n. 凯里（等于Cary）

examples.en: Carey promised to call me after the movie ended.
examples.zh: 凯里答应电影结束后给我打电话。

meaning: vt. 环绕, 围绕, 包围

examples.en: A tall wooden fence encircles the old garden.
examples.zh: 一道高高的木栅栏环绕着老花园。

meaning: n. 胃, 肚子

examples.en: My tummy hurts after eating too much cake.
examples.zh: 吃了太多蛋糕后我肚子疼。

meaning: n. (自治市的)市民, 自由民;自治市公民, 市民

examples.en: In medieval times, a burgess could vote in town meetings.
examples.zh: 在中世纪，自由民可以在镇上的会议中投票。

meaning: n. 短裤, 灯笼裤

examples.en: The boy wore knickers and long socks in the old photo.
examples.zh: 老照片里那个男孩穿着灯笼裤和长袜。

meaning: n. 里斯本(葡萄牙首都)

examples.en: We spent a whole week exploring Lisbon last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们用了一整周游览里斯本。

meaning: vt. 重新发现

examples.en: I rediscovered my love for painting during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期里我重新发现了自己对绘画的热爱。

meaning: n. 小修道院

examples.en: The old priory by the river is now a museum.
examples.zh: 河边那座旧修道院现在是一家博物馆。

meaning: pron. 你

examples.en: I shall miss thee, my dear old friend.
examples.zh: 我会想念你的，我亲爱的老朋友。

meaning: n. 用钩子的人, 渔船

examples.en: The old hooker boat returned to port with a full catch.
examples.zh: 那艘旧渔船满载而归回到了港口。

meaning: a. 推迟的, 迟延的;递延的

examples.en: We deferred our picnic until the rain stopped.
examples.zh: 我们把野餐推迟到雨停之后。

meaning: a. 授权的;v. 授权（authorise的过去式）

examples.en: Only authorised people can open this safety door.
examples.zh: 只有获得授权的人才能打开这扇安全门。

meaning: n. 溜冰场, 室内溜冰场;vi. 溜冰

examples.en: The children skated happily on the ice rink.
examples.zh: 孩子们在溜冰场上开心地滑冰。

meaning: n. 佛兰德斯（中世纪欧洲一伯爵领地, 包括现比利时 的以及法国各一地区）

examples.en: Many poppies grow in the fields of Flanders.
examples.zh: 佛兰德斯的田野里生长着许多罂粟花。

meaning: n. 熟食店；熟食品（等于delicatessen）

examples.en: I bought fresh sandwiches at the deli on Main Street.
examples.zh: 我在主街的熟食店买了新鲜三明治。

meaning: n. 逆火, 回火, 放火;vi. 放逆火, 预先放火, 发生意外

examples.en: His plan to cheat on the test will backfire badly.
examples.zh: 他考试作弊的计划适得其反，后果很糟。

meaning: a. 明白的, 率直的, 十足的;adv. 全然, 彻底, 完全

examples.en: That answer was downright rude, and she knew it.
examples.zh: 那个回答简直太粗鲁了，她自己心里清楚。

meaning: n. 横笛, 吹横笛;v. 吹横笛

examples.en: He played the fife while the soldiers marched.
examples.zh: 士兵们行进时他吹着横笛。

meaning: n. 约书亚(<<圣经>>人物), <<约书亚记>>

examples.en: Joshua borrowed three books from the school library.
examples.zh: 约书亚从学校图书馆借了三本书。

meaning: n. 弥赛亚

examples.en: The choir sang the Messiah at the Christmas concert.
examples.zh: 唱诗班在圣诞音乐会上演唱了《弥赛亚》。

meaning: n. 绝经期;绝经

examples.en: The doctor kindly explained what happens during menopause.
examples.zh: 医生耐心地解释了更年期期间身体的变化。

meaning: n. 鸫, 鹅口疮, 蹄叉腐烂;鹅口疮, 真菌性口炎; 口炎性腹泻; 铸道(牙)

examples.en: A thrush sang sweetly in the garden this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早晨一只画眉在花园里婉转地歌唱。

meaning: 邮局, 邮政汇票;口服, 经口

examples.en: My little sister hugs her Po doll every night.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天晚上都抱着她的波娃娃睡觉。

meaning: vt. 使出轨;n. 脱轨器

examples.en: An accident on the track derailed the evening train.
examples.zh: 轨道上的一起事故使晚间列车脱轨了。

meaning: n. 股权

examples.en: Her shareholding in the company grew over ten years.
examples.zh: 她在这家公司的持股十年间不断增长。

meaning: vt. 以较小尺寸设计；缩小尺寸；裁减人数

examples.en: The company had to downsize to save money.
examples.zh: 公司不得不缩减规模以节省开支。

meaning: n. 改革, 改正, 重新形成, 重新组成

examples.en: The old church was built before the Reformation.
examples.zh: 这座老教堂建于宗教改革之前。

meaning: n. 泰尔福特路面(由大石与碎石作基础,再用小石经辗压坚实筑成平滑面层的一种路面)

examples.en: Telford designed many famous bridges and canals in Britain.
examples.zh: 特尔福德在英国设计了许多著名的桥梁和运河。

meaning: n. 爱斯基摩人划子

examples.en: We rented a kayak and paddled around the bay.
examples.zh: 我们租了一艘皮划艇，在海湾里划来划去。

meaning: n. 科隆, 科隆香水

examples.en: He bought a small bottle of cologne at the airport.
examples.zh: 他在机场买了一小瓶古龙水。

meaning: n. 店面

examples.en: The bakery's storefront was painted bright yellow.
examples.zh: 面包店的店面漆成了亮黄色。

meaning: n. 农庄, 田庄

examples.en: The farmers meet at the grange every Friday night.
examples.zh: 农民们每周五晚上在农庄会堂聚会。

meaning: v. 击败( defeat的过去式和过去分词 ); 战胜; 挫败; 使困惑

examples.en: Our team defeated the champions two to nothing.
examples.zh: 我们队以二比零击败了卫冕冠军。

meaning: a. 有两极的, 双极的;双极性

examples.en: The doctor helps people who live with bipolar disorder.
examples.zh: 这位医生帮助患有双相情感障碍的病人。

meaning: n. 苏黎士

examples.en: We changed trains in Zurich on the way to Italy.
examples.zh: 去意大利的路上我们在苏黎世换乘了火车。

meaning: 伍斯特郡

examples.en: Mum added a few drops of Worcestershire sauce to the stew.
examples.zh: 妈妈往炖菜里加了几滴伍斯特酱。

meaning: n. 辛克莱(m.)

examples.en: Sinclair keeps all his old comics in a wooden box.
examples.zh: 辛克莱把所有旧漫画都收在一个木箱里。

meaning: a. 可征税的, 应征税的;可征税的, 应纳税的

examples.en: His yearly bonus counts as taxable income.
examples.zh: 他的年度奖金属于应税收入。

meaning: a. 整理过的；巩固的；统一的

examples.en: The three schools were consolidated into one big campus.
examples.zh: 三所学校合并成了一个大学校。

meaning: 移生, 移地发育; 集中护理(精神病人)

examples.en: The museum explores the history of colonization in the region.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆探讨了该地区殖民的历史。

meaning: a. 畏缩的, 怯懦的, 恶臭的

examples.en: This cafe plays funky music all day long.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆整天播放节奏感强的音乐。

meaning: n. 清教徒;a. 清教徒的

examples.en: The Puritan settlers arrived here nearly four hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 清教徒移民大约四百年前来到这里。

meaning: n. 酒吧间男招待

examples.en: The barman poured me a glass of cold lemonade.
examples.zh: 酒保给我倒了一杯冰柠檬水。

meaning: n. 牧草地, 草原

examples.en: Wide grassland stretches beyond the small village.
examples.zh: 广阔的草原延伸到小村庄之外。

meaning: n. 要塞, 堡垒, 大本营

examples.en: The castle was a stronghold during the medieval wars.
examples.zh: 那座城堡在中世纪战争期间是一座堡垒。

meaning: n. 教师

examples.en: My grandmother was a schoolteacher in a small mountain village.
examples.zh: 我祖母曾在一个小山村当老师。

meaning: a. 聚焦的；专心的

examples.en: Stay focused on your homework for twenty more minutes.
examples.zh: 再专心做二十分钟作业。

meaning: n. 西伯利亚

examples.en: Wolves still roam the frozen forests of Siberia.
examples.zh: 狼仍在西伯利亚的冰冻森林中出没。

meaning: 梅德斯通(肯特郡首府)

examples.en: They moved to Maidstone after their wedding last year.
examples.zh: 去年婚礼后他们搬到了梅德斯通。

meaning: n. 声明, 公告, 宣言, 宣告, 发表, 意见, 决定;宣判, 宣布, 宣告

examples.en: The judge's pronouncement ended the long court case.
examples.zh: 法官的裁决结束了这场漫长的官司。

meaning: n. 分裂, 破碎;在IP层将打包文件切成适当大小的程序

examples.en: The fragmentation of the empire led to many small states.
examples.zh: 帝国的分裂导致出现了许多小国。

meaning: a. 空气的, 空中的, 通风的, 幻想的, 轻快的

examples.en: The new apartment feels bright and airy.
examples.zh: 新公寓明亮又通风。

meaning: n. 长靠背椅

examples.en: Grandpa naps on the settee every afternoon.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天下午在长椅上打盹。

meaning: n. 鳗鱼, 鳝鱼

examples.en: We saw a long eel swimming near the rocks.
examples.zh: 我们看见一条长鳗鱼在岩石附近游动。

meaning: 重新设计

examples.en: They plan to redesign the school library this summer.
examples.zh: 他们计划今年夏天重新设计学校图书馆。

meaning: n. 蒙特利尔（加拿大东南部港市）

examples.en: My cousin studies French in Montreal.
examples.zh: 我表弟在蒙特利尔学法语。

meaning: n. 瀑布, 斜槽;斜槽; 滑槽; 滑运道

examples.en: The laundry falls down the chute to the basement.
examples.zh: 脏衣服顺着滑道落到地下室。

examples.en: The hospital has a special unit for neurological patients.
examples.zh: 这家医院设有神经疾病患者的专门病区。

examples.zh: 教练总是强调团队合作的首要地位。

meaning: meet的过去式和过去分词;甲硫氨酸; 蛋氨酸

examples.en: We met at the bus stop this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我们在公交站碰面了。

meaning: n. 长披风

examples.en: From Inverness we drove north to see the lake.
examples.zh: 我们从因弗内斯开车北上去看湖。

meaning: n. 氯化物;氯化物; 盐酸盐

examples.en: Table salt is made of sodium and chloride.
examples.zh: 食盐由钠和氯化物构成。

meaning: n. 银行；斜床；岸, 堤（bank的复数形式）

examples.en: We had a picnic on the banks of the river.
examples.zh: 我们在河岸上野餐。

meaning: vi. 建立理论, 讲理论, 推理

examples.en: Scientists theorize that the stars formed billions of years ago.
examples.zh: 科学家推测这些恒星形成于数十亿年前。

meaning: n. 摩门教徒

examples.en: The Mormon community settled in this valley long ago.
examples.zh: 摩门教社区很久以前在这个山谷定居。

meaning: n. 不信任;vt. 不信任

examples.en: Years of broken promises created deep distrust between the families.
examples.zh: 多年的失信让两个家庭之间产生了深深的不信任。

meaning: n. 刈幅, 刈下的一行草, 刈下的一行麦, 行, 一条, 条, 一行

examples.en: The tornado cut a swath through the farmland.
examples.zh: 龙卷风在农田中划出了一条长带。

meaning: 巴恩斯利(南约克郡首府)

examples.en: Barnsley is a town in the north of England.
examples.zh: 巴恩斯利是英格兰北部的一个小镇。

meaning: n. 沃特金斯

examples.en: Watkins scored the winning goal in the final minute.
examples.zh: 沃特金斯在最后一分钟打进了制胜球。

meaning: n. 莫桑比克

examples.en: She spent two years teaching English in Mozambique.
examples.zh: 她在莫桑比克教了两年英语。

meaning: a. 合唱队的

examples.en: The choral concert drew a large crowd last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的合唱音乐会吸引了大批观众。

meaning: 硬件描象层

examples.en: Hal forgot his lunchbox on the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 哈尔把午餐盒忘在厨房桌上了。

meaning: n. 沙皇

examples.en: The czar ruled the country for more than twenty years.
examples.zh: 沙皇统治这个国家二十多年。

meaning: n. 陆军准将, 准将

examples.en: The brigadier inspected the troops at dawn.
examples.zh: 准将在黎明时检阅了部队。

meaning: adv. 强调地, 着重地

examples.en: She emphatically denied breaking the vase.
examples.zh: 她坚决否认打碎了花瓶。

meaning: n. 李尔

examples.en: King Lear is one of Shakespeare's saddest plays.
examples.zh: 《李尔王》是莎士比亚最悲伤的剧作之一。

meaning: n. 车道, 道路, 轨道;道路, 路面, 快车道

examples.en: Workers repaired the roadway outside our school all week.
examples.zh: 工人们一整周都在修我们学校外的行车道。

meaning: n. 斯托克波特（英国一城市）

examples.en: They run a small bookshop in Stockport.
examples.zh: 他们在斯托克波特经营一家小书店。

meaning: n. 包装者, 包裹者, 包装物, 覆盖物, 外包烟叶, 包纸, 书的封皮, 妇女晨衣;包裹料

examples.en: She folded the sweet wrapper into a tiny star.
examples.zh: 她把糖纸折成了一颗小星星。

meaning: 密闭, 紧密

examples.en: The closeness between the twins surprised everyone.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎之间的亲密让所有人惊讶。

meaning: n. 伯爵夫人, 女伯爵

examples.en: The countess hosted a grand dinner at her castle.
examples.zh: 女伯爵在她的城堡里举办了一场盛大的晚宴。

meaning: v. 怒吼

examples.en: The angry sergeant began to bellow orders at the soldiers.
examples.zh: 愤怒的中士开始对士兵们大声下达命令。

meaning: a. 通货膨胀的, 通货膨胀倾向的

examples.en: The government introduced new measures to fight inflationary pressure.
examples.zh: 政府推出了新措施来应对通胀压力。

meaning: abbr. 英国政府公务（Her/ His Majesty's Service）；皇家海军舰艇（Her/ His Majesty's Ship）

examples.en: HMS Belfast is now a museum on the river.
examples.zh: 贝尔法斯特号战舰现在是河上的一座博物馆。

meaning: n. 裁军;裁军, 解除军备

examples.en: The leaders met to discuss nuclear disarmament.
examples.zh: 各国领导人开会讨论核裁军问题。

meaning: n. 小群, 隶属的小组织, 子群;族; 族周期表; 副族(指周期表中B族); 子群; 亚群(生物分类); 族(数)

examples.en: Each subgroup presented its findings to the whole class.
examples.zh: 每个小组向全班展示了他们的调查结果。

meaning: n. 曼谷

examples.en: The streets of Bangkok are busy even at midnight.
examples.zh: 曼谷的街道即使在午夜也很热闹。

meaning: a. 更新的；现代化的

examples.en: I updated my phone apps before the flight.
examples.zh: 起飞前我更新了手机上的应用。

meaning: n. 游击手, 停显液

examples.en: Our shortstop caught the ball and threw it home.
examples.zh: 我们的游击手接住球并传回了本垒。

meaning: n. 巴洛刀(一种坚实而廉价的单面小折刀, 亦作 barlow knife)

examples.en: Barlow lives next door with two noisy cats.
examples.zh: 巴洛和两只吵闹的猫住在隔壁。

meaning: n. 举起, 拿起, 理解, 上风井, 摄入, 吸收;摄取

examples.en: The uptake of online classes grew rapidly last year.
examples.zh: 去年网课的使用量迅速增长。

examples.en: The old sofa was unattractive but very comfortable.
examples.zh: 那张旧沙发不好看，但非常舒服。

meaning: adv. 错误地, 被误解地

examples.en: I mistakenly took your umbrella home yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我错把你的雨伞拿回家了。

meaning: n. 铅块, 监狱, 四方院子, 四胞胎, 四胞胎中的一个孩子, 成套的四件东西;四芯导线

examples.en: The students gathered in the quad after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后学生们聚集在校园的四方院里。

meaning: n. 多元文化

examples.en: Multiculturalism brings many exciting festivals to our city.
examples.zh: 多元文化给我们的城市带来许多精彩的节日。

meaning: a. 落下的, 坠落的, 下降的;消胀

examples.en: Leaves are falling from the trees outside my window.
examples.zh: 窗外的树叶正从树上落下。

meaning: adv. 锐利地, 敏捷地, 激烈地

examples.en: She keenly watches every match her team plays.
examples.zh: 她热切地观看她球队的每场比赛。

meaning: a. 强制执行的；实施的

examples.en: The new rule was enforced starting this Monday.
examples.zh: 新规定从本周一开始严格执行。

meaning: a. 有雾的, 模糊的, 笼罩着雾的

examples.en: We drove through the misty mountains at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时我们开车穿过雾蒙蒙的群山。

meaning: n. 挂钩, 吊架, 衣架, 挂衣钩;(挂在店内的)广告牌

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hanger by the door.
examples.zh: 把外套挂在门边的衣架上。

meaning: a. 挤满的; 过度拥挤的;v. 拥挤(overcrowd的过去式和过去分词)

examples.en: The subway is overcrowded during the morning rush.
examples.zh: 早高峰时地铁里非常拥挤。

meaning: n. (英)便士, 小便;vi. 小便

examples.en: The puppy needs to pee again after drinking water.
examples.zh: 小狗喝水后又想撒尿了。

meaning: a. 受好评的, 有声望的, 规范的;声誉好的, 可尊敬的

examples.en: Buy your laptop from a reputable shop.
examples.zh: 要从信誉好的商店买笔记本电脑。

meaning: adv. 会意地, 心照不宣地, 故意地, 有意地, 老练地;心照不宣地, 故意地, 有意地

examples.en: He knowingly broke the library rules by eating inside.
examples.zh: 他明知故犯，在图书馆里吃东西。

meaning: a. 补缀的, 凑合的, 不调和的, 散落的, 斑驳的, 不完全的

examples.en: The fog is patchy this morning, so drive slowly.
examples.zh: 今晨雾时有时无，开车要慢一点。

meaning: n. 罪人, 不知礼仪的人, 无赖;罪人, 无赖

examples.en: The story says every sinner deserves a second chance.
examples.zh: 故事说每个罪人都该得到第二次机会。

meaning: a. 装饰的, 修饰的

examples.en: The children decorated the classroom with paper flowers.
examples.zh: 孩子们用纸花装饰了教室。

meaning: a. 顽固的, 任性的, 性急的, 猛烈的

examples.en: The heady scent of jasmine filled the evening air.
examples.zh: 茉莉花浓郁的香气充满了夜晚的空气。

meaning: adv. 在军事上

examples.en: The country is militarily stronger than its neighbours.
examples.zh: 这个国家在军事上比邻国强大。

meaning: a. 分居；分开的；不在一起生活的

examples.en: The twins were separated into different classes this year.
examples.zh: 今年双胞胎被分到了不同的班级。

meaning: n. 后座, 次要位置

examples.en: The kids argued loudly in the backseat the whole way.
examples.zh: 孩子们一路上在后座大声争吵。

meaning: n. 罐, 筒, 霰弹;罐, 滤毒罐

examples.en: Store the flour in an airtight canister.
examples.zh: 把面粉存放在密封罐里。

meaning: n. 衰败, 大雨

examples.en: Lying to his fans led to the singer's downfall.
examples.zh: 对歌迷撒谎导致了这位歌手的垮台。

meaning: adv. 人工地, 人为地, 不自然地

examples.en: This juice drink is artificially coloured and flavoured.
examples.zh: 这种果汁饮料是人工色素和香精调制的。

meaning: a. 假的, 虚构的, 不真实的, 幻想的

examples.en: Standing on the stage felt completely unreal to her.
examples.zh: 站在舞台上让她感觉完全不像真的。

meaning: a. 可用的, 方便使用的, 能用的

examples.en: These old planks are still usable for the treehouse.
examples.zh: 这些旧木板还可以用来搭树屋。

meaning: n. 抗氧化剂, 防老化剂;抗氧剂; 抗氧化剂; 防老剂; 防老化剂

examples.en: Doctors say vitamin C acts as a useful antioxidant.
examples.zh: 医生说维生素C是一种有用的抗氧化剂。

meaning: adv. 险峻地

examples.en: The path rises steeply behind the old church.
examples.zh: 小路在老教堂后面陡然上升。

meaning: 接收

examples.en: She is receiving treatment at the city hospital.
examples.zh: 她正在市医院接受治疗。

meaning: n. (交战国间的)停火执行者(或小组)

examples.en: The peacekeeper helped villagers rebuild the small school.
examples.zh: 维和人员帮助村民重建了小学校。

meaning: n. 水疱;砂眼

examples.en: My new boots gave me a painful blister.
examples.zh: 我的新靴子把脚磨出了疼痛的水泡。

meaning: a. 愤怒的, 狂暴的, 猛烈的, 使极痛的

examples.en: The raging river carried logs past our camp.
examples.zh: 汹涌的河水把原木冲过了我们的营地。

meaning: n. 转环, 旋转轴承, 转椅座架;v. (使)旋转

examples.en: The office chair can swivel all the way around.
examples.zh: 这把办公椅可以整圈旋转。

meaning: n. 尖端, 突出部分;v. (使)突出, 伸出

examples.en: Sharp rocks jut out from the cliff face.
examples.zh: 嶙峋的岩石从崖壁上突出来。

meaning: n. 喷溅声, 劈啪声, 语无伦次;vi. 唾沫飞溅, 结结巴巴地讲, 发劈啪声

examples.en: The old engine began to sputter on the hill.
examples.zh: 老发动机上坡时开始噗噗作响。

meaning: a. 轻视的

examples.en: He was dismissive of my idea before hearing it fully.
examples.zh: 他没听完就对我的想法不屑一顾。

meaning: v. 恶化, 变坏( deteriorate的现在分词 )

examples.en: The old bridge is deteriorating and needs repairs soon.
examples.zh: 那座旧桥状况不断恶化，需要尽快维修。

meaning: a. 多洞穴的

examples.en: The cat escaped through a gaping hole in the fence.
examples.zh: 猫从栅栏上的大洞里逃了出去。

meaning: n. 报刊经销商

examples.en: I buy my morning paper at the newsagent.
examples.zh: 我在报刊店买早报。

meaning: n. 推土机;推土机

examples.en: A bulldozer cleared the rubble from the old lot.
examples.zh: 推土机清走了旧工地上的瓦砾。

meaning: n. 幽灵, 妖怪, 凶兆

examples.en: Locals say a spectre haunts the ruined abbey at night.
examples.zh: 当地人说那座废弃的修道院夜里闹鬼。

meaning: a. 凶狠的, 杀人的, 致命的;谋杀的, 杀人的, 残酷的

examples.en: The villain gave the hero a murderous glare.
examples.zh: 反派凶狠地瞪了主人公一眼。

meaning: adv. 过早地, 贸然地

examples.en: The baby was born prematurely but is healthy now.
examples.zh: 宝宝早产了，但现在很健康。

meaning: adv. 神秘地; 不可思议地; 诡秘地; 故弄玄虚地

examples.en: The lights mysteriously went out at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时灯神秘地熄灭了。

meaning: n. 灯火管制, 暂时的意识丧失, 灯火熄灭, 删除;电网掉电

examples.en: We lit candles during the blackout last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚停电时我们点起了蜡烛。

meaning: a. 冰冷的；装冰的；冰冻的

examples.en: She ordered an iced coffee with extra milk.
examples.zh: 她点了一杯多加牛奶的冰咖啡。

meaning: a. 对...没有感觉的, 感觉迟钝的;感觉迟钝的

examples.en: His insensitive joke hurt her feelings deeply.
examples.zh: 他那不得体的玩笑深深伤害了她。

meaning: a. 不切实际的, 不能实行的, 不现实的, 不合情理的

examples.en: Wearing heels on a hiking trail is impractical.
examples.zh: 穿高跟鞋走登山步道很不实用。

meaning: vt. 给...戴上手铐;n. 手铐

examples.en: The police officer showed us his shiny handcuffs.
examples.zh: 警察向我们展示了他闪亮的手铐。

meaning: n. 救助者, 救世主, 救星

examples.en: The lifeguard was hailed as the saviour of the boy.
examples.zh: 救生员被誉为那个男孩的救命恩人。

meaning: a. 附属的；与…有关的

examples.en: Please read the documents pertaining to your loan.
examples.zh: 请阅读与你的贷款相关的文件。

meaning: a. 昂贵的, 价格高的

examples.en: That new restaurant is tasty but very pricey.
examples.zh: 那家新餐厅味道好但是价格很贵。

meaning: n. 炽热, 热诚, 热情, 热烈

examples.en: The fans cheered with fervour as the band played.
examples.zh: 乐队演奏时歌迷们热情高涨地欢呼。

meaning: n. (一副)耳机;头载机组

examples.en: The pilot's headset stopped working during the flight.
examples.zh: 飞行员的耳机在飞行中出了故障。

meaning: n. 戏耍, 喧闹, 宴会, 狂饮;vi. 狂欢, 狂饮

examples.en: She went on a shopping spree after getting paid.
examples.zh: 发工资后她去疯狂购物了一回。

meaning: a. 修改的；改变信仰的

examples.en: The old barn was converted into a cosy home.
examples.zh: 旧谷仓被改造成了一个温馨的家。

meaning: 运载

examples.en: He entered quietly, carrying a tray of hot tea.
examples.zh: 他端着一托盘热茶悄悄走了进来。

meaning: a. 不受抑制的, 不受控制的, 自由的

examples.en: Uncontrolled fires can destroy whole forests in days.
examples.zh: 失控的火灾几天内就能烧毁整片森林。

meaning: a. 出生以前的, 孕期的;产前的, 出生前的

examples.en: She attends prenatal classes every Thursday evening.
examples.zh: 她每周四晚上去上产前课。

meaning: n. 钛;钛Ti

examples.en: Her new watch is made of lightweight titanium.
examples.zh: 她的新手表由轻巧的钛金属制成。

meaning: n. 注视, 沉思, 盘算;默察, 意图, 期待

examples.en: He sat in quiet contemplation by the lake.
examples.zh: 他静静地在湖边坐着沉思。

meaning: adj .讨厌之极的

examples.en: The chef kept flipping the pancakes in the pan.
examples.zh: 厨师不停地翻动锅里的煎饼。

meaning: a. 稀少的, 珍贵的, 罕见的

examples.en: Buses are infrequent in the countryside after six.
examples.zh: 六点以后乡村的班车班次很少。

meaning: a. 幽灵的, 影子似的, 精神的

examples.en: A ghostly figure seemed to float down the stairs.
examples.zh: 一个幽灵般的身影仿佛飘下了楼梯。

meaning: n. 文体学家, 时装设计师

examples.en: The stylist cut my hair far too short.
examples.zh: 发型师把我的头发剪得太短了。

meaning: a. 飘浮着的, 在海上的, 浸满水的, 在进行中的;adv. 飘浮着, 在海上, 浸满水, 在进行中

examples.en: Life jackets kept the kids afloat in the pool.
examples.zh: 救生衣让孩子们浮在泳池水面上。

meaning: v. 集合；装配（assemble的过去分词）

examples.en: The whole family assembled in the kitchen for dinner.
examples.zh: 全家人聚在厨房里吃晚饭。

meaning: a. 无疑的, 确实的;无疑的, 确实的

examples.en: Her undoubted talent shines in every performance.
examples.zh: 她毋庸置疑的才华在每场演出中都闪闪发光。

meaning: n. 沉溺, 放纵, 嗜好;宽容, 纵容, 赎罪券

examples.en: Eating chocolate cake for breakfast is a rare indulgence.
examples.zh: 早餐吃巧克力蛋糕是难得的放纵。

meaning: a. 不能辨别的, 不能区别的

examples.en: The twins were indistinguishable in their matching sweaters.
examples.zh: 双胞胎穿着同款毛衣，根本分不清。

meaning: n. 吉格快步舞, 快步舞曲, 带锤子的钓钩, 夹具;v. 乱跳, 加工用钩钓鱼, 选筛

examples.en: The fishermen danced a quick jig on the dock.
examples.zh: 渔民们在码头上跳起了欢快的吉格舞。

meaning: a. 可想像的, 可能的

examples.en: The store sells ice cream in every flavour imaginable.
examples.zh: 这家店出售各种能想到的口味的冰淇淋。

meaning: n. 木制品, 木制家具, 木工手艺, 木工活, 房屋内的木建部分

examples.en: Grandpa makes beautiful boxes in his woodwork room.
examples.zh: 爷爷在他的木工房里做漂亮的盒子。

meaning: adv. 客观地

examples.en: Try to look at the problem objectively, not emotionally.
examples.zh: 尽量客观地看这个问题，不要感情用事。

meaning: adv. 在内部, 向中心, 向内, 内里;进口税

examples.en: The tent folds inwards when you collapse it.
examples.zh: 收帐篷的时候它会向内折叠。

meaning: a. 秘书的, 书记的

examples.en: She took a secretarial job at the hospital.
examples.zh: 她在医院找了份秘书工作。

meaning: n. 摔跤选手

examples.en: The wrestler smiled gently at the nervous little fans.
examples.zh: 摔跤手对着紧张的小粉丝们温柔地笑了。

meaning: vt. 再断言, 重复主张

examples.en: The team hopes to reassert its dominance this season.
examples.zh: 这支球队希望本赛季重振霸主地位。

meaning: n. 雪撬;vt. 用雪撬搬运

examples.en: We pulled the sled up the snowy hill together.
examples.zh: 我们一起把雪橇拉上了雪坡。

meaning: adv. 一前一后地, 纵排地;a. 纵排的, 串联的

examples.en: They cycled into town on a tandem bicycle.
examples.zh: 他们骑着一辆双人自行车进了城。

meaning: a. 引起疲劳的, 累人的;轮箍术(髌骨骨折时)

examples.en: Carrying boxes all day was tiring but well paid.
examples.zh: 搬一整天箱子很累，但报酬不错。

meaning: vt. 使动摇

examples.en: The scandal threatened to destabilize the young government.
examples.zh: 丑闻有可能动摇这个新生的政府。

meaning: 最低的, 基层的

examples.en: Shop early for the lowest prices of the season.
examples.zh: 早点购物才能赶上全季最低价。

meaning: a. 刀口锐利的, 尖利的, 急躁的

examples.en: He felt edgy before the big exam.
examples.zh: 大考前他感到紧张不安。

meaning: v. 减少；衰减；递减；削弱…的权势（diminish的现在分词）

examples.en: Support for the plan is diminishing among students.
examples.zh: 学生们对这个计划的支持正在减少。

meaning: a. 该受的, 有功的, 值得...的;n. 功过, 赏罚

examples.en: She works hard and is deserving of the award.
examples.zh: 她工作努力，应该获得这个奖项。

meaning: a. 无正式文件的, 无事实证明的

examples.en: Millions of undocumented workers live in this country.
examples.zh: 数百万无证工人生活在这个国家。

meaning: adv. 向上游, 逆流地;a. 向上游的, 逆流而上的

examples.en: We paddled upstream until our arms were tired.
examples.zh: 我们逆流划船，划到手臂发酸。

meaning: a. 受审查的, 被删剪的;v. 删剪（书籍、电影等中被认为犯忌、违反道德或政治上危险的内容）( censor的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: Some scenes were censored before the film aired.
examples.zh: 电影播出前有些镜头被删剪了。

meaning: a. 爬行的, 令人毛骨悚然的

examples.en: That empty house looks creepy after dark.
examples.zh: 那栋空房子天黑后显得阴森吓人。

meaning: 心神稳定

examples.en: We enjoyed the tranquillity of the mountain lake.
examples.zh: 我们尽情享受山间湖泊的宁静。

meaning: v. 仔细翻寻, 仔细搜查, 检查出;n. 仔细翻找, 查出的物件

examples.en: I always rummage through my bag for the house keys.
examples.zh: 我在包里翻来翻去找家门钥匙。

meaning: n. 中微子;中微子; 微中子

examples.en: A neutrino can pass through the earth untouched.
examples.zh: 中微子可以穿过地球而不受任何影响。

meaning: a. 拖延的

examples.en: The protracted negotiations delayed the opening of the new school.
examples.zh: 漫长的谈判拖延了新学校的开办。

meaning: vt. 使负义务, 强使, 使感激, 施恩惠于;a. 有责任的, 必须的

examples.en: The contract does not obligate you to stay.
examples.zh: 这份合同并不强制你留下。

meaning: n. (接)目镜;目镜

examples.en: Adjust the eyepiece until the image becomes sharp.
examples.zh: 调节目镜直到影像变得清晰。

meaning: a. 不能分的;不可分的

examples.en: The puppy and the kitten are inseparable friends.
examples.zh: 小狗和小猫是形影不离的好朋友。

meaning: n. 小鸟

examples.en: She made a birdie on the eighth hole.
examples.zh: 她在第八洞打出了小鸟球。

meaning: n. 英国人

examples.en: The festival celebrates both Anglo and Hispanic traditions.
examples.zh: 这个节日同时庆祝英裔和拉美裔的传统。

meaning: 浇铸, 浇注

examples.en: Rain came pouring down as we ran to the car.
examples.zh: 我们跑向汽车时大雨倾盆而下。

meaning: adv. 坚持地; 固执地; 一个劲儿

examples.en: The doorbell rang persistently until someone answered.
examples.zh: 门铃一直响个不停，直到有人去开门。

meaning: vt. 改造, 改型, 改变

examples.en: They plan to remodel the kitchen this spring.
examples.zh: 他们打算今年春天改造厨房。

meaning: adv. 特别, 尤其, 奇怪地

examples.en: The old house smells peculiarly of apples and cinnamon.
examples.zh: 这栋老房子有股苹果和肉桂的怪味。

meaning: n. 羊皮纸, 毕业文凭, 学位证书

examples.en: The recipe was written on yellowed parchment.
examples.zh: 这份食谱写在发黄的羊皮纸上。

meaning: n. 莳萝, 土茴香子;枯茗; 欧莳萝; 异丙苯

examples.en: Add a teaspoon of ground cumin to the soup.
examples.zh: 往汤里加一茶匙磨碎的孜然。

meaning: a. 受委屈的, 权利受到不法侵害的

examples.en: The aggrieved customers demanded a full refund.
examples.zh: 愤愤不平的顾客要求全额退款。

meaning: a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的;油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油质的; 多油的; 油腻的; 油滑的

examples.en: Wash your hands after eating those oily chips.
examples.zh: 吃完那些油腻的薯条要洗手。

meaning: a. 安在马上的, 裱好的

examples.en: The police officer mounted her horse for patrol duty.
examples.zh: 女警察骑上马开始巡逻。

meaning: n. 仲夏, 夏至期;a. 仲夏的

examples.en: The village holds its fair every year at midsummer.
examples.zh: 村庄每年仲夏时节都举办集市。

meaning: vt. 滴注, 逐渐灌输, 不断灌输;滴注

examples.en: Teachers try to instil a love of reading early.
examples.zh: 老师们努力从小就培养孩子对阅读的热爱。

meaning: n. 孢子;vi. 长孢子

examples.en: Each spore can grow into a new mushroom.
examples.zh: 每个孢子都能长成新的蘑菇。

meaning: vt. 定制, 按规格改制, 定做;定制

examples.en: You can customize your phone with different wallpapers.
examples.zh: 你可以用不同的壁纸来个性化你的手机。

meaning: a. 有倒刺的

examples.en: The farmer put up a barbed fence around the sheep.
examples.zh: 农夫在羊群周围竖起了带刺的栅栏。

meaning: vt. 猛击, 重打, 削减;vi. 重击

examples.en: He gave the drum a loud whack with his stick.
examples.zh: 他用鼓棒重重地敲了一下鼓。

meaning: n. 洗衣人, 垫圈, 洗衣机;洗涤器; 垫圈

examples.en: The tap was leaking, so Dad replaced the rubber washer.
examples.zh: 水龙头漏水，爸爸换了橡胶垫圈。

meaning: vt. 使惊恐, 恐吓;vi. 实施恐怖统治

examples.en: The pirates used to terrorize ships along this coast.
examples.zh: 海盗过去常在这片海岸袭扰船只。

meaning: vt. 使可见, 使具体化, 使具形象;vt.vi. 设想, 想象

examples.en: Close your eyes and visualise a calm sandy beach.
examples.zh: 闭上眼睛，想象一片平静的沙滩。

meaning: a. 合法的, 正直的, 恰当的;正当的, 合法的, 依法有求权的

examples.en: The painting was returned to its rightful owner.
examples.zh: 这幅画回到了它真正主人的手中。

meaning: a. 静止的；休眠的

examples.en: The cat is resting on the warm laundry pile.
examples.zh: 猫正卧在温暖的衣物堆上休息。

meaning: int. 哦！噢！（表示抗议, 厌恶, 讨厌等）

examples.en: Aw, look at that tiny kitten sleeping.
examples.zh: 哇，快看那只睡着的小猫咪。

meaning: n. 泛音, 暗示, 弦外之音, 折光的色彩;陪音, 泛音

examples.en: His polite words carried an overtone of annoyance.
examples.zh: 他礼貌的话语中带着一丝恼怒的意味。

meaning: n. 小软团, 小软块, 一卷, 填料, 大量;vt. 揉成一团, 填塞

examples.en: He pulled a wad of notes from his pocket.
examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出了一沓钞票。

meaning: a. 压抑的, 压下的, 沉闷的;抑郁的, 阻抑的, 压低的

examples.en: Gentle exercise helps many people with depressive illness.
examples.zh: 温和的运动对许多抑郁症患者有帮助。

meaning: adv. 谨慎地, 小心地

examples.en: She discreetly slipped the note into her pocket.
examples.zh: 她不动声色地把纸条塞进了口袋。

meaning: a. 骨骼的, 框架的;骨胳的

examples.en: Archaeologists found the skeletal remains of an ancient horse.
examples.zh: 考古学家发现了一匹古代马的骨骼残骸。

meaning: 定向的

examples.en: The new ads are targeted at young football fans.
examples.zh: 这些新广告面向年轻的球迷群体。

meaning: n. 竞技表演;牛市场

examples.en: We watched bull riding at the rodeo in Texas.
examples.zh: 我们在德克萨斯的牛仔竞技会上看了骑牛比赛。

meaning: n. 爱好, 嗜好

examples.en: The new coffee blend is much to my liking.
examples.zh: 这款新咖啡非常合我的口味。

meaning: n. 国际法学家, 政治评论家, 政治作家, 广告员;国际法学家, 公法学家, 政治学

examples.en: Her publicist handled all the interview requests.
examples.zh: 她的公关负责人处理了所有采访请求。

meaning: a. 恐吓的, 威胁的;威胁的, 恐吓的, 险恶的

examples.en: The storm clouds looked dark and menacing.
examples.zh: 暴风雨前的乌云看起来阴沉吓人。

meaning: v. 使（人或人的身体）非常虚弱( debilitate的现在分词 )

examples.en: Migraines can be debilitating for many workers.
examples.zh: 偏头痛可能让许多劳动者无法正常工作。

meaning: 地理的

examples.en: The canal has huge geopolitical importance for trade.
examples.zh: 这条运河对贸易有着巨大的地缘政治重要性。

meaning: a. 熙熙攘攘的, 忙乱的

examples.en: We wandered through the bustling night market till midnight.
examples.zh: 我们在熙熙攘攘的夜市一直逛到半夜。

meaning: v. 向东, 朝向

examples.en: The map helped us orientate ourselves in the old town.
examples.zh: 地图帮助我们在老城里辨明了方向。

meaning: n. 劈啪响, 裂纹;vi. (使)发劈啪声

examples.en: The campfire began to crackle as the wind rose.
examples.zh: 起风时营火开始噼啪作响。

meaning: vi.vt. (使)物质化, (使)具体化, (使)追求物质利益, (使)显形, 成为事实, 实现;vi. 突然出现

examples.en: Our beach picnic failed to materialise because of rain.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们的海滩野餐计划没能实现。

meaning: n. 台布

examples.en: Mum spread a clean white tablecloth for dinner.
examples.zh: 妈妈为晚餐铺上了干净的白桌布。

meaning: n. 伦敦繁华的大街之一

examples.en: We met at the fountain at Piccadilly Circus.
examples.zh: 我们在皮卡迪利广场的喷泉旁见面。

meaning: a. 不起帮助作用的, 无用的, 无益的, 不予帮助的, 不予合作的

examples.en: The manual was unhelpful and badly translated.
examples.zh: 这本手册没什么用处，翻译也很糟糕。

meaning: n. 坐着的人, 坐着被画像的人

examples.en: The sitter arrives at seven so we can go out.
examples.zh: 保姆七点到，这样我们就能出门。

meaning: n. 中途, 中间, 娱乐场;a. 中途的, 中间的

examples.en: We stopped midway through the hike for a snack.
examples.zh: 徒步走到一半我们停下来吃点心。

meaning: v. 出版( issue的现在分词 ); 发表; 宣布; 分配; 发行者( issuer的现在分词 )

examples.en: The office is issuing new student cards this week.
examples.zh: 办公室本周正在发放新的学生证。

meaning: n. 裁剪和试样的服装工人/裁缝, 装配工, 钳工;管工

examples.en: I feel much fitter since I started walking to work.
examples.zh: 自从步行上班以来，我感觉身体好多了。

meaning: n. 瓦解;破碎; 崩解; 蜕变

examples.en: Freeze and thaw speed up the disintegration of the rock.
examples.zh: 反复的冻融加速了岩石的崩解。

meaning: n. 医院收容, 住院治疗;住院, 入院

examples.en: The injury led to a week of hospitalization.
examples.zh: 这次受伤让他住院了一周。

meaning: 计费的;充电; 装料

examples.en: My phone is charging in the kitchen right now.
examples.zh: 我的手机现在正在厨房充电。

meaning: n. 可敬, 有社会地位, 高尚, 体面, 习俗

examples.en: The prize gave the young scientist instant respectability.
examples.zh: 这个奖项让这位年轻科学家立刻声望大增。

meaning: n. 覆盖, 覆盖图, 使负担过重;overlie的过去式

examples.en: The map shows an overlay of bus and train routes.
examples.zh: 这张地图叠加显示了公交和火车线路。

meaning: n. 礼拜仪式, 祷告文, 圣餐仪式

examples.en: The choir practises the liturgy every Friday evening.
examples.zh: 唱诗班每周五晚上排练礼拜仪式经文。

meaning: n. 常态;规定浓度; 当量浓度

examples.en: After the storm, the town slowly returned to normality.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，小镇慢慢恢复了正常。

meaning: a. 活跃的, 忙碌的, 激动人心的;调和; 搅拌

examples.en: A stirring speech moved everyone in the hall.
examples.zh: 一场激动人心的演讲打动了礼堂里的每个人。

meaning: a. 未诞生的, 未来的, 在胎内的;未诞生的, 未来的, 原来存在的

examples.en: The song is a letter to her unborn child.
examples.zh: 这首歌是写给她未出生孩子的一封信。

meaning: lead的过去式和过去分词;发光二极管

examples.en: Our guide led us safely through the dark cave.
examples.zh: 向导带领我们安全穿过了黑暗的山洞。

meaning: a. 地位低的, 卑下的, 谦卑的;adv. 位置低下的, 低声地, 谦逊地

examples.en: He started as a lowly clerk in the mailroom.
examples.zh: 他从收发室里一名低微的职员做起。

meaning: a. 变硬的；坚定的

examples.en: Years at sea had hardened the old sailor's skin.
examples.zh: 常年的海上生活使老水手的皮肤变得粗糙。

meaning: a. 不让步的, 不妥协的, 坚定的;坚定的, 不受协的, 不能通融的

examples.en: Her uncompromising honesty sometimes surprises her friends.
examples.zh: 她毫不妥协的坦诚有时让朋友们吃惊。

meaning: n. 克罗地亚人；克罗地亚语

examples.en: Our taxi driver was a Croat who loved football.
examples.zh: 我们的出租车司机是个热爱足球的克罗地亚人。

meaning: adv. 怜悯地, 同情地

examples.en: The nurse listened sympathetically to the worried mother.
examples.zh: 护士满怀同情地倾听着这位母亲的担忧。

meaning: n. 加利福尼亚州人;a. 加利福尼亚的

examples.en: They drove the whole Californian coast last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天他们开车走完了加州海岸。

meaning: n. 费用, 经费, 支出;vt. 花费

examples.en: The initial outlay for the bakery was quite small.
examples.zh: 这家面包店的初期投入相当少。

meaning: n. 破坏者, 消灭者, 起破坏作用的东西, 驱逐舰

examples.en: The destroyer escorted the cargo ships across the ocean.
examples.zh: 驱逐舰护送货船横渡大洋。

meaning: n. 推挤, 冲撞;vi. 推挤, 冲撞

examples.en: Fans jostle each other to catch the bride's bouquet.
examples.zh: 宾客们互相推挤着去接新娘的捧花。

meaning: 平衡, 均衡, 结算;平衡, 结出余额

examples.en: Balancing school and a part-time job is hard.
examples.zh: 兼顾学业和兼职工作很难。

meaning: adv. 浓密地, 浓厚地

examples.en: The city centre is densely packed with tiny cafes.
examples.zh: 市中心密密麻麻全是小咖啡馆。

meaning: v. 向…祝酒, 为…干杯( toast的过去式和过去分词 ); 烤火, 取暖, 使暖和

examples.en: We toasted the bread and spread it with jam.
examples.zh: 我们烤了面包并涂上了果酱。

meaning: n. 再生, 复活, 新生

examples.en: The old theatre is enjoying a rebirth this decade.
examples.zh: 这家老剧院在这十年间迎来了新生。

meaning: vt. 止住, 止血;a. 坚固的, 坚强的, 忠实的, 忠诚的, 不透水的

examples.en: He is a staunch supporter of the local team.
examples.zh: 他是本地球队的坚定支持者。

meaning: n. 桦树, 桦木, 桦条;桦

examples.en: A tall birch tree shades our kitchen window.
examples.zh: 一棵高大的桦树遮蔽了我们厨房的窗户。

meaning: a. 好奇的, 被迷住了的;v. 搞阴谋诡计(intrigue的过去式); 激起…的兴趣或好奇心; “intrigue”的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: I was intrigued by the strange symbols on the old box.
examples.zh: 旧箱子上的奇怪符号引起了我的好奇心。

meaning: abbr. buzzer 蜂音器, 蜂鸣器

examples.en: Buz is the nickname my sister gave our robot vacuum.
examples.zh: 布兹是我妹妹给扫地机器人起的名字。

meaning: n. 打字, 键入;键入

examples.en: Grandma practises typing so she can email her friends.
examples.zh: 奶奶练习打字，好给朋友们发邮件。

meaning: n. 有插画的报章杂志

examples.en: The illustrated edition has a picture on every page.
examples.zh: 插图版每一页都有一幅画。

meaning: 干燥的;干燥

examples.en: The towels are drying on the line in the sun.
examples.zh: 毛巾正在阳光下晾晒。

meaning: n. 羚羊

examples.en: A fast antelope leapt across the desert road.
examples.zh: 一只敏捷的羚羊跃过了沙漠公路。

meaning: a. 有符号的；有正负之分的；已签字的

examples.en: The author signed my copy of her new novel.
examples.zh: 作者在我那本新小说上签了名。

meaning: a. 凭灵感的, 鼓舞人心的, 神感的

examples.en: The paralympic athlete gave an inspirational talk at our school.
examples.zh: 残奥会运动员在我们学校做了一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

meaning: n. 寿司（生鱼片冷饭团）

examples.en: We shared a big plate of sushi at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐时我们分享了一大盘寿司。

meaning: n. 戴在头上的收话器, 耳机;头载数话器

examples.en: My left headphone buzzes when the bass is loud.
examples.zh: 低音太响时我的左耳机就会嗡嗡作响。

meaning: a. 快乐的, 愉快的, 舒适的, 心情舒畅的

examples.en: A long hot bath after hiking is very pleasurable.
examples.zh: 徒步之后泡个热水澡非常惬意。

meaning: n. 〈植〉牛至

examples.en: Sprinkle some dried oregano over the pizza.
examples.zh: 在披萨上撒一些干牛至叶。

meaning: n. steward的职务, 管理工作

examples.en: Good stewardship keeps the forest healthy for future generations.
examples.zh: 良好的管理让森林为子孙后代保持生机。

meaning: n. 胫骨;v. 攀, 爬

examples.en: The football hit him right on the shin.
examples.zh: 足球正好撞在他的小腿上。

meaning: n. 弥补, 添字首音

examples.en: With his new prosthesis he can run again.
examples.zh: 装上新的假肢后他又能跑步了。

meaning: n. 冲浪运动员

examples.en: The surfer rode the wave all the way in.
examples.zh: 冲浪者一路乘着海浪滑到了岸边。

meaning: n. 使重新统一, 使重新团结

examples.en: The fall of the wall led to Germany's reunification.
examples.zh: 柏林墙的倒塌促成了德国的统一。

meaning: a. 论题的, 题目的, 时事问题的, 局部的;局部的

examples.en: The show mixes comedy with topical news stories.
examples.zh: 这档节目把喜剧和时事新闻结合了起来。

meaning: n. 结带, 纽带, 韧带;韧带

examples.en: She tore a ligament in her knee during practice.
examples.zh: 她在训练中撕裂了膝盖的韧带。

meaning: n. 扑通声, 掉下;adv. 扑通一声地

examples.en: The frog jumped into the pond with a plop.
examples.zh: 青蛙扑通一声跳进了池塘。

meaning: a. 有城墙的

examples.en: The old city is completely walled with seven gates.
examples.zh: 古城完全被城墙环绕，共有七座城门。

meaning: a. 被杀死的, 被屠宰的, 镇静的

examples.en: The frost killed all our tomato plants overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜寒霜冻死了我们所有的番茄苗。

meaning: n. 天花;天花, 痘疮

examples.en: Vaccines wiped out smallpox more than forty years ago.
examples.zh: 疫苗在四十多年前就消灭了天花。

meaning: a. 未特别指出的, 未特别提到的

examples.en: He left for an unspecified destination early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一早他动身去了一个不明目的地。

meaning: n. 仪表板, 挡泥板

examples.en: The red warning light on the dashboard started flashing.
examples.zh: 仪表盘上的红色警示灯开始闪烁。

meaning: a. 穿衣服的, 既得的, 既定的;既得的, 法定的

examples.en: Employees have a vested interest in the company's success.
examples.zh: 员工与公司的成功有着切身利害关系。

meaning: a. 胀大的, 肥胖的, 喘气的, 一阵阵吹的;虚肿的, 浮肿的

examples.en: Her eyes were puffy after crying at the film.
examples.zh: 看电影哭过之后她的眼睛都肿了。

meaning: a. 依大小排列的, 依大小调整的, 型号的, ...尺码的

examples.en: These gloves are sized from small to extra large.
examples.zh: 这些手套从特小号到特大号都有。

meaning: a. 波罗的海的

examples.en: The ferry crosses the Baltic Sea in fourteen hours.
examples.zh: 渡轮用十四个小时横渡波罗的海。

meaning: vi. 保持联络, 担任联络官

examples.en: I liaise with the suppliers about delivery dates.
examples.zh: 我负责与供应商联络发货日期。

meaning: n. 犹太人的离散, 离散的犹太人

examples.en: The festival brings together the Irish diaspora every summer.
examples.zh: 这个节日每年夏天都会汇聚爱尔兰裔侨民。

meaning: a. 萌芽的, 发育期的, 初露头角的;n. 发芽

examples.en: The budding musician practises the violin before school.
examples.zh: 这位初露头角的小音乐家上学前会练小提琴。

meaning: n. 高加索人, 白种人;a. 高加索的, 白种人的

examples.en: Caucasian languages include Georgian and Chechen.
examples.zh: 高加索语言包括格鲁吉亚语和车臣语。

meaning: vt. 再引进, 再介绍

examples.en: The park plans to reintroduce wolves next spring.
examples.zh: 公园计划明年春天重新引入狼群。

meaning: n. 流血

examples.en: After years of bloodshed the two sides finally signed peace.
examples.zh: 经过多年的流血冲突，双方终于签署了和平协议。

meaning: n. 宿醉, 残留物, 遗物;残存物

examples.en: He drank too much and woke up with a hangover.
examples.zh: 他喝得太多，醒来后宿醉了。

meaning: n. 茴香;茴香

examples.en: The soup is made with potatoes, fennel and cream.
examples.zh: 这道汤用土豆、茴香和奶油做成。

meaning: n. 萨满教巫医;巫师

examples.en: The tribe's shaman sang as the fire burned low.
examples.zh: 部落的萨满在篝火渐弱时吟唱起来。

meaning: adv. 忙碌地

examples.en: The bees were busily collecting nectar from the flowers.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂正忙着从花朵上采集花蜜。

meaning: adv. 勇敢地

examples.en: The little girl bravely told the dentist about her pain.
examples.zh: 小女孩勇敢地告诉牙医她哪里疼。

meaning: n. 闪电战;vt. 以闪电战攻击

examples.en: We did a cleaning blitz before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到来之前我们突击打扫了一番。

meaning: adv. 可靠地, 可信赖地

examples.en: This old truck starts reliably even on cold mornings.
examples.zh: 这辆旧卡车即使在寒冷的早晨也能可靠启动。

meaning: vt. 象征, 代表, 作为...的象征;vt.vi. 用符号表示, 使用符号

examples.en: The olive branches symbolise peace in the painting.
examples.zh: 画中的橄榄枝象征着和平。

meaning: n. 沉没, 降低, 衰颓感;偿还债务

examples.en: The sailors left the sinking ship in small boats.
examples.zh: 水手们乘小船离开了正在下沉的船。

meaning: a. 令人烦恼的, 麻烦的, 劳碌命的

examples.en: The report reveals worrisome trends in teen sleep habits.
examples.zh: 这份报告揭示了青少年睡眠习惯的令人担忧的趋势。

meaning: a. 没有被听到的, 未予倾听的, 未予考虑的

examples.en: Her complaints went unheard for many long months.
examples.zh: 她的投诉好多个月都无人理睬。

meaning: n. 占有, 居住, 占用;占据, 据有, 占用

examples.en: Hotel occupancy drops sharply during the winter months.
examples.zh: 冬季酒店入住率会大幅下降。

meaning: n. 种植者, 耕作者, 种植机, 花盆

examples.en: Mum planted herbs in a wooden planter by the door.
examples.zh: 妈妈在门边的木花箱里种了香草。

meaning: n. (投手投出的)快球

examples.en: The pitcher's fastball flew past the surprised batter.
examples.zh: 投手的快球飞过了措手不及的击球手。

meaning: a. 小的, 次要的, 小个子的, 娇小玲珑的, 娇小的

examples.en: The petite dancer lifted her partner with ease.
examples.zh: 娇小的舞者轻松地举起了舞伴。

meaning: v. 表达( express的过去式和过去分词 ); （用符号等）表示; 榨; [express oneself]（如在说话、写作或绘画中）表达（自己）的意见

examples.en: She expressed her thanks with a box of chocolates.
examples.zh: 她用一盒巧克力表达了自己的谢意。

meaning: a. 使感动的, 动感情的, 感情的;情绪的, 动感情的

examples.en: The charity used emotive photos in its campaign.
examples.zh: 慈善机构在宣传活动中使用了感人的照片。

meaning: n. 担架, 延伸器;担架

examples.en: Paramedics carried the injured hiker onto a stretcher.
examples.zh: 急救人员把受伤的徒步者抬上了担架。

meaning: 电视广播

examples.en: The song quickly filled the airwaves that summer.
examples.zh: 那年夏天这首歌迅速占据了各大电台。

meaning: a. 无瑕疵的, 无缺点的;无裂纹的; 无裂缝的

examples.en: Her performance was absolutely flawless from start to finish.
examples.zh: 她的表演从头到尾都完美无瑕。

meaning: n. 一滴, 小斑点;vt. 溅污

examples.en: A small blob of paint fell on my shoe.
examples.zh: 一小滴颜料掉在了我的鞋上。

meaning: n. 痉挛, 抽搐, 发作;痉挛

examples.en: A sudden spasm in his leg stopped the runner.
examples.zh: 腿部突然的痉挛让这名跑者停了下来。

meaning: n. 脚手架, 上演, 公共马车业;登台

examples.en: The clever staging made the tiny stage look huge.
examples.zh: 巧妙的舞台调度让小舞台显得很大。

meaning: vi. 中断, 终止, 停止;vt. 使中止

examples.en: The company will discontinue this phone model next month.
examples.zh: 公司下个月将停产这款手机。

meaning: n. 裂解, 分解;a. 敏捷的, 很好的

examples.en: We heard cracking sounds from the frozen lake.
examples.zh: 我们听到冰封的湖面传来噼啪的碎裂声。

meaning: n. 苜蓿属植物, 医师, 医科学生

examples.en: A medic treated the player's cut on the sideline.
examples.zh: 场边一名医护人员处理了球员的伤口。

meaning: n. 关门, 停工, 停机;停工

examples.en: The factory shutdown left hundreds without work.
examples.zh: 工厂停工让数百人失去了工作。

meaning: n. 荒谬, 悖理, 荒谬的言行

examples.en: We laughed at the absurdity of the situation.
examples.zh: 我们为这荒诞的场面大笑起来。

meaning: a. 药用的, 药的, 有益的;药用的, 医药的, 医治的

examples.en: Some plants in the garden have medicinal uses.
examples.zh: 花园里的一些植物具有药用价值。

meaning: a. 有目的的;有意图的, 有目的的, 故意的

examples.en: She walked into the room with purposeful steps.
examples.zh: 她迈着坚定的步伐走进了房间。

meaning: n. 柳条;a. 柳条编的

examples.en: Grandma keeps her sewing things in a wicker basket.
examples.zh: 奶奶把针线活用品放在柳条篮里。

meaning: n. 蕃茄酱

examples.en: He puts ketchup on almost everything he eats.
examples.zh: 他吃几乎什么东西都要加番茄酱。

meaning: n. 诱因, 动机, 吸引力, 刺激物;诱惑, 引诱, 诱因

examples.en: The bonus was an inducement to finish the project early.
examples.zh: 这笔奖金是促使项目提前完成的激励。

meaning: n. 火柴, 比赛, 竞赛, 匹配, (足球, 捧球, 蓝球)比赛;v. 相配, 相称, 比赛, 相比, 匹配

examples.en: Fans are excited about tonight's basketball matchup.
examples.zh: 球迷们对今晚的篮球对阵充满期待。

meaning: n. 洗手间；休息室；更衣室；厕所

examples.en: The restroom on the second floor is being cleaned.
examples.zh: 二楼的洗手间正在打扫。

meaning: a. 碾碎的, 压倒的;粗碎; 压碎; 破碎

examples.en: The team suffered a crushing defeat in the final.
examples.zh: 球队在决赛中遭遇了惨败。

meaning: vt. 用大写字母写, 用大写字母印, 投资于, 使变为资本, 提供资本给;vi. 利用

examples.en: The firm hopes to capitalise on the new trend.
examples.zh: 公司希望利用这一新趋势获利。

meaning: adv. 可怕地, 非常地

examples.en: The play went horribly wrong when the lights failed.
examples.zh: 灯光出故障后演出变得一团糟。

meaning: n. 有毒瘾者, 废旧品商人

examples.en: He is a coffee junkie who needs five cups daily.
examples.zh: 他是个咖啡迷，每天要喝五杯。

meaning: 波旁

examples.en: Kentucky is famous for its smooth bourbon whiskey.
examples.zh: 肯塔基州以顺滑的波本威士忌闻名。

meaning: n. 回想, 回忆, 怀旧, 话旧

examples.en: Grandpa shared a fond reminiscence of his school days.
examples.zh: 爷爷深情地回忆起了他的学生时代。

meaning: a. 改革过的, 改革派的

examples.en: The reformed thief now teaches kids about honesty.
examples.zh: 改过自新的小偷如今教孩子们要诚实。

meaning: n. 尖叫, 抱怨;vi. 发出尖叫声, 高声埋怨

examples.en: The children squeal with delight at the puppy's tricks.
examples.zh: 小狗的把戏让孩子们高兴得尖叫。

meaning: a. 上诉的, 有权受理上诉的;受理上诉的, 上诉的, 控诉的

examples.en: The case was sent to the appellate court in May.
examples.zh: 这起案件五月被移交到了上诉法院。

meaning: a. 乳汁的, 银河的, 极大的;乳液的, 催乳液的

examples.en: The sci-fi film shows battles across the galactic empire.
examples.zh: 这部科幻片展现了横跨银河帝国的战斗。

meaning: n. 背部, 背后, 后方

examples.en: He slipped on the ice and landed on his backside.
examples.zh: 他滑倒在冰上，摔了个屁股蹲儿。

meaning: n. 颧骨

examples.en: The boxer's cheekbone was bruised after the match.
examples.zh: 比赛结束后拳击手的颧骨淤青了。

meaning: a. 丝的, 柔滑的

examples.en: The puppy's fur is soft and silky.
examples.zh: 小狗的毛又柔软又顺滑。

meaning: 帕丁顿

examples.en: Paddington is a busy station in central London.
examples.zh: 帕丁顿是伦敦市中心一个繁忙的车站。

meaning: n. 尾部, 臀部;臀部, 臀

examples.en: Buy a rump steak for the barbecue tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚烧烤时买一块后腿牛排。

meaning: adv. 从那时起, 从那时以后, 从那里起, 由此, 因此

examples.en: We toured Rome and thence travelled north to Florence.
examples.zh: 我们游览了罗马，再从那里北上佛罗伦萨。

meaning: 耐久性, 耐用性, 持久性

examples.en: Hikers praise the durability of these mountain boots.
examples.zh: 徒步者们称赞这双登山鞋的耐用性。

meaning: n. 人类

examples.en: Printing changed the course of humankind forever.
examples.zh: 印刷术永远改变了人类的进程。

meaning: n. 蛋黄酱

examples.en: Mix the tuna with two spoons of mayonnaise.
examples.zh: 把金枪鱼和两勺蛋黄酱拌在一起。

meaning: n. 聚乙烯;聚乙烯

examples.en: The sandwiches were wrapped in clear polythene sheets.
examples.zh: 三明治用透明的聚乙烯薄膜包着。

meaning: a. 未被注意的, 无记号的, 无标志的

examples.en: An unmarked police car followed the van slowly.
examples.zh: 一辆无标识的警车慢慢地跟着那辆货车。

meaning: adv. 钟爱地, 亲切地

examples.en: She lovingly arranged the flowers in a blue vase.
examples.zh: 她细心地把花插进了蓝色花瓶。

meaning: n. 未婚夫

examples.en: Her fiance is learning Chinese before the wedding.
examples.zh: 她的未婚夫正在为婚礼学中文。

meaning: n. 做梦的人, 梦想者

examples.en: Everyone called him a dreamer, but he opened his cafe.
examples.zh: 大家都说他是梦想家，可他真的开了咖啡馆。

meaning: a. 特质的, 异质的, 特殊的;特应性的, 特异体质的

examples.en: The director is known for her idiosyncratic filming style.
examples.zh: 这位导演以她独特的拍摄风格著称。

meaning: n. 烛光, 黄昏

examples.en: We ate dinner by candlelight when the power went out.
examples.zh: 停电时我们借着烛光吃晚饭。

meaning: adv. 粗糙地, 粗俗地, 鄙俗地

examples.en: Coarsely chop the nuts before adding them to the cake.
examples.zh: 把坚果粗粗切碎后再加入蛋糕糊。

meaning: 接线的

examples.en: The connecting train to Oxford leaves from platform two.
examples.zh: 开往牛津的接续火车从二号站台出发。

meaning: a. 人种间的, 人种混合的

examples.en: Interracial marriages are common in our neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 我们社区里跨种族婚姻很常见。

meaning: n. 地基, 基础, 根据

examples.en: Months of groundwork preceded the launch of the project.
examples.zh: 项目启动之前做了数月的基础工作。

meaning: n. 助产士, 接生婆;助产士

examples.en: The midwife visited the new mother every morning.
examples.zh: 助产士每天早上都来看望新妈妈。

meaning: n. 智利人, 智利讲的西班牙语;a. 智利文化的, 智利人的, 智利的

examples.en: The Chilean miners were rescued after sixty-nine days.
examples.zh: 智利矿工在被困六十九天后获救。

meaning: n. 财政家, 金融家;vi. 从事欺骗性金融活动, 欺骗

examples.en: A wealthy financier donated the new wing of the museum.
examples.zh: 一位富有的金融家捐建了博物馆的新翼。

meaning: n. 基要主义

examples.en: The seminar debated the roots of religious fundamentalism.
examples.zh: 研讨会辩论了宗教原教旨主义的根源。

meaning: 维护和平的, 执行停火协定的

examples.en: Canadian troops joined the peacekeeping mission abroad.
examples.zh: 加拿大部队加入了海外维和任务。

meaning: n. 吹笛, 笛声, 管道, 尖锐声音, 衣服滚边;a. 吹笛的, 高音的, 平静的, 乐声优雅的

examples.en: Serve the soup piping hot with fresh bread.
examples.zh: 汤要滚烫上桌，再配上新鲜面包。

meaning: n. 文化互渗, 文化适应

examples.en: The study explores acculturation among immigrant families.
examples.zh: 这项研究探讨了移民家庭的文化适应。

meaning: n. 断路器;破碎机

examples.en: A large breaker crashed against the harbour wall.
examples.zh: 一个大浪猛烈地撞在了防波堤上。

meaning: 设陷, 陷入, 俘获;截留; 捕俘

examples.en: Trapping rabbits is banned in the national park.
examples.zh: 国家公园里禁止捕猎兔子。

meaning: a. 随后的, 以后的

examples.en: Succeeding in music takes both talent and practice.
examples.zh: 在音乐上取得成功需要天赋和练习。

meaning: a. 被通缉的

examples.en: The police caught the wanted thief at the station.
examples.zh: 警察在车站抓到了被通缉的窃贼。

meaning: a. 吓人的, 可怕的, 害怕的

examples.en: The Vikings were known as fearsome sailors.
examples.zh: 维京人以可怕的水手著称。

meaning: n. 值得想望, 可取;合意性, 可用性

examples.en: The report questioned the desirability of building the new road.
examples.zh: 这份报告质疑了修建这条新路的可取性。

meaning: n. 淫秽, 淫秽的语言(或行为、动作), 可憎的事;猥亵, 淫诲, 猥亵的言语或行动

examples.en: The broadcaster was fined for obscenity last month.
examples.zh: 那家广播公司上月因播出淫秽内容被罚款。

meaning: n. 愚蠢, 糊涂事;迟钝

examples.en: He apologised for the stupidity of his remark.
examples.zh: 他为自己愚蠢的言论道了歉。

meaning: n. 奖章获得者, 奖章设计者, 奖章制作者, 勋章制作者, 奖章搜集者, 勋章搜集者

examples.en: The gold medalist waved to the cheering crowd.
examples.zh: 金牌得主向欢呼的人群挥手致意。

meaning: adv. 明显地；公开地, 公然地

examples.en: The film was overtly critical of the government.
examples.zh: 这部电影公开批评了政府。

meaning: n. 肾上腺素;肾上腺素

examples.en: Adrenalin surged through her body before the race.
examples.zh: 起跑之前她体内肾上腺素激增。

meaning: a. 不整齐的, 肮脏的, 破旧的, 褴褛的

examples.en: The scruffy dog followed us home from the park.
examples.zh: 那只邋遢的狗从公园一路跟我们回了家。

meaning: a. 环境形成的；情形的

examples.en: The training focuses on situational awareness for drivers.
examples.zh: 这项培训的重点是司机的情境意识。

meaning: n. 指南, 手册, 要览

examples.en: This guidebook lists the best cheap restaurants in Rome.
examples.zh: 这本指南列出了罗马最好的廉价餐厅。

meaning: n. 斯德哥尔摩

examples.en: We watched boats glide through Stockholm in the sunshine.
examples.zh: 阳光下我们看着船只驶过斯德哥尔摩。

meaning: n. 卡姆登（姓）

examples.en: Camden Market is great for vintage clothes.
examples.zh: 卡姆登市场很适合淘复古服装。

meaning: n. 成年, 勇气, 男儿;成年身分, 成年, 男子

examples.en: The old film explores ideas of manhood and courage.
examples.zh: 这部老电影探讨了男子气概与勇气。

meaning: n. 男教师, 男校长, 教导者

examples.en: The strict schoolmaster rang the bell at eight sharp.
examples.zh: 严厉的校长八点整敲响了上课铃。

meaning: adv. 潇洒地, 火辣辣地, 刺痛地

examples.en: The guard turned smartly and saluted the officer.
examples.zh: 卫兵利落地转身向军官敬礼。

meaning: 记入, 记录, 稿件, 邮件;过帐, 誊入总帐

examples.en: Her next posting is a small office in Kenya.
examples.zh: 她的下一个派驻岗位是肯尼亚的一个小办事处。

meaning: n. 软泥, 泥泞;沉淀物; 泥状沉淀

examples.en: Thick sludge blocked the drain behind the garage.
examples.zh: 浓稠的污泥堵住了车库后面的下水道。

meaning: n. 肉豆蔻;肉豆蔻

examples.en: Grate a little nutmeg over the warm milk.
examples.zh: 在热牛奶上磨一点点肉豆蔻。

meaning: n. 无效率, 无能;效率低; 效率差

examples.en: The report blamed the delay on bureaucratic inefficiency.
examples.zh: 这份报告把延误归咎于官僚机构的低效。

meaning: adv. 向后, 朝后, 突然, 船顶风地

examples.en: His sudden anger took me completely aback.
examples.zh: 他突然发火让我完全不知所措。

meaning: 假资优, 天才, 资赋优异

examples.en: The program nurtures the giftedness of talented students.
examples.zh: 该项目致力于培养资优学生的天赋。

meaning: n. 合法, 正当;合法性

examples.en: The lawyers questioned the legality of the new rule.
examples.zh: 律师们质疑了新规定的合法性。

meaning: n. 取者, 捕者, 接受者, 收取者;受者, 收票人, 接受打赌的人

examples.en: As a bold risk taker, she invests in startups.
examples.zh: 作为一个大胆的冒险者，她投资初创公司。

meaning: a. 没有防卫的, 无掩护的, 未设防的, 没有保护人的, 不受关税保护的;无保护的, 非保护的

examples.en: Unprotected skin burns quickly in this mountain sun.
examples.zh: 在这种山间阳光下，无防护的皮肤很快就会晒伤。

meaning: n. 中国官话, 国语, 满清官吏, 柑橘;a. (中国式)紧身马褂的

examples.en: She is learning Mandarin before her trip to Beijing.
examples.zh: 去北京之前她正在学习普通话。

meaning: adv. 口头地, 非书面地

examples.en: The teacher verbally praised the shy student's progress.
examples.zh: 老师口头表扬了那位害羞学生的进步。

meaning: conj. 因此, 于是

examples.en: He refused to apologise, whereupon she left the room.
examples.zh: 他拒绝道歉，于是她离开了房间。

meaning: n. (美国)红杉, 红树

examples.en: We walked among the giant redwood trees in California.
examples.zh: 我们在加州的巨杉林中漫步。

meaning: n. 填塞物, 填料

examples.en: The turkey stuffing is made with onions and sage.
examples.zh: 火鸡填料是用洋葱和鼠尾草做的。

meaning: n. 译码;编码

examples.en: She practises coding for an hour after school.
examples.zh: 她放学后会练习一小时编程。

meaning: n. 宇宙哲学, 宇宙论;宇宙论

examples.en: His lectures on cosmology attract huge audiences.
examples.zh: 他关于宇宙学的讲座吸引了大量听众。

meaning: n. 疲劳, 疲倦;疲惫, 疲倦

examples.en: Tiredness affects your memory and focus.
examples.zh: 疲劳会影响你的记忆力和专注力。

meaning: vt.vi. 想象, 出现幻想, 产生幻想, 使幻想化, 幻想

examples.en: She likes to fantasize about living on a desert island.
examples.zh: 她喜欢幻想自己住在荒岛上。

meaning: n. 维修;维护, 修理

examples.en: The lift will be out of use during servicing.
examples.zh: 电梯维修保养期间将停止使用。

meaning: a. 理想主义的, 唯心论的, 唯心主义的, 唯心主义者的

examples.en: The idealistic students dreamed of changing the world.
examples.zh: 理想主义的学生们梦想着改变世界。

meaning: a. 阿拉斯加的；阿拉斯加州的

examples.en: An Alaskan cruise offers views of glaciers and whales.
examples.zh: 阿拉斯加游轮之旅可以观赏冰川和鲸鱼。

meaning: a. 遗传的；继承权的；通过继承得到的

examples.en: She inherited her grandmother's ring and her green eyes.
examples.zh: 她继承了祖母的戒指和绿眼睛。

meaning: a. 狡猾的, 逃避的, 难弄的

examples.en: That website looks dodgy, so do not enter your card details.
examples.zh: 那个网站看起来很可疑，别输入银行卡信息。

meaning: n. 武器, 军备, 武器设计研制学

examples.en: The museum displays ancient weaponry from many cultures.
examples.zh: 博物馆陈列着来自多种文化的古代武器。

meaning: n. 雌鹿;a. 后部的, 在后的

examples.en: The horse kicked at the flies with its hind legs.
examples.zh: 那匹马用后腿踢赶苍蝇。

meaning: a. 像银的, 银色的, 银铃一般的

examples.en: The lake turned silvery in the evening light.
examples.zh: 湖水在暮色中泛着银光。

meaning: a. 隐退的, 隐蔽的

examples.en: We found a secluded beach with no other visitors.
examples.zh: 我们找到了一处没有其他游人的僻静海滩。

meaning: a. 西藏的;n. 藏语, 西藏人

examples.en: The Tibetan monks chanted in a low, steady voice.
examples.zh: 藏族僧侣们用低沉平稳的声音诵经。

meaning: a. 有教养的, 有修养的, 有知识的

examples.en: Her cultured tastes include opera and French cinema.
examples.zh: 她的高雅品味包括歌剧和法国电影。

meaning: v. 恐吓, 威逼( bully的现在分词 ); 豪; 跋扈

examples.en: The school has strict rules against bullying.
examples.zh: 学校对欺凌行为有严格的处罚规定。

meaning: v. 谈判, 协商, 议定( negotiate的过去式和过去分词 ); 兑现（支票等）; 通过, 越过（险要路段）

examples.en: The two sides finally negotiated a fair price.
examples.zh: 双方最终谈成了一个公平的价格。

meaning: n. 宾夕法尼亚

examples.en: My cousin studies engineering at a university in Pennsylvania.
examples.zh: 我表哥在宾夕法尼亚的一所大学学工程。

meaning: n. 成本计算, 成本会计;成本计算

examples.en: The new kitchen is costing us far more than we planned.
examples.zh: 新厨房的花销比我们计划的要多得多。

meaning: n. 相当于“You all“, 美国南部使用, 意思是“大家”

examples.en: Y'all should come over for dinner this Friday night.
examples.zh: 你们这周五晚上来我家吃晚饭吧。

meaning: n. 上现蜃景；庞视；幽影

examples.en: Dark clouds were looming over the mountains before the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨来临前,乌云渐渐笼罩了群山。

meaning: n. 皱叶甘兰

examples.en: She bought a green savoy cabbage for the winter soup.
examples.zh: 她买了一颗皱叶甘蓝,准备做冬日浓汤。

meaning: n. 一种轻型旅行袋；格拉德斯通, 格莱斯顿（英国政治家）

examples.en: We passed a statue of Gladstone in the park this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上我们在公园里经过一座格拉德斯通雕像。

meaning: v. 解放, 释放( liberate的现在分词 )

examples.en: Moving to the countryside felt liberating after years in the city.
examples.zh: 在城市住了多年后,搬到乡下让人感觉自由自在。

meaning: n. 百吉饼（先蒸后烤的发面圈）；（体育比赛中）零蛋

examples.en: I grabbed a cream cheese bagel on my way to work.
examples.zh: 上班路上我买了一个奶油奶酪贝果。

meaning: 克拉彭

examples.en: She rents a small flat in Clapham with two friends.
examples.zh: 她和两个朋友在克拉珀姆合租一套小公寓。

meaning: n. 小海生动物, 小鲱鱼

examples.en: Several Brits at the conference complained about the weak coffee.
examples.zh: 会上几位英国人抱怨咖啡太淡。

meaning: n. 班机, 大型客机

examples.en: The airliner made an emergency landing after losing an engine.
examples.zh: 一架客机在引擎失效后紧急降落。

meaning: n. <美>牛栏,<口>大房间(尤指候审犯人用的),候补队员区

examples.en: The pitcher warmed up in the bullpen before the game started.
examples.zh: 比赛开始前,投手在牛棚里热身。

meaning: vt.vi. (使)稳定, (使)安定, (使)坚固;vt. 装稳定器

examples.en: Doctors gave him medicine to stabilise his heart rate.
examples.zh: 医生给他用药以稳定心率。

meaning: vt. 做(恶), 犯(罪), 胡说, 恶劣地做;犯, 作, 行

examples.en: Police believe the same gang perpetrated both robberies last month.
examples.zh: 警方认为上月两起抢劫都是同一个团伙干的。

meaning: vt. 分类, 归类

examples.en: The librarian categorises the books by subject and author.
examples.zh: 图书管理员按主题和作者给书分类。

meaning: burn的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The toast got burnt because I was talking on the phone.
examples.zh: 我打电话聊天时,吐司烤糊了。

meaning: n. 尖声喊叫, 尖叫声, 煞车声;vt. 尖声讲

examples.en: We heard the screech of car brakes outside our window.
examples.zh: 我们听到窗外传来汽车刹车的刺耳声。

meaning: 出席人, 参加者, 被照顾者, 被服务者

examples.en: Each attendee at the workshop received a free notebook.
examples.zh: 工作坊的每位参加者都领到一个免费笔记本。

meaning: vt. 使合理, 合理地处理, 使有理化;vi. 合理地思考

examples.en: She tried to rationalize buying yet another pair of shoes.
examples.zh: 她极力为再买一双鞋找理由。

meaning: n. 不肥沃, 不毛;不育症, 不孕症

examples.en: The clinic offers support for couples dealing with infertility.
examples.zh: 这家诊所为受生育问题困扰的夫妇提供帮助。

meaning: a. 上坡的, 向上的;adv. 往上坡, 向上地

examples.en: The last mile of the hike was steeply uphill.
examples.zh: 徒步的最后一英里是陡峭的上坡路。

meaning: n. 不信神, 无信仰, 背信

examples.en: The film explores how a marriage survives infidelity and distrust.
examples.zh: 这部电影探讨婚姻如何承受背叛与不信任。

meaning: a. 已冷的, 冷硬了的, 冷冻了的;冷却了的, 冷凝了的, 淬火迟的

examples.en: We sipped chilled lemonade on the porch all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整个下午我们坐在门廊上喝冰镇柠檬水。

meaning: a. 每小时的, 以小时计的, 频繁的;adv. 每小时地, 频繁地, 不绝地

examples.en: The station displays hourly updates about train delays.
examples.zh: 车站每小时更新列车晚点信息。

meaning: a. 使人眩目的, 使人失去判断力的;n. 碎石子

examples.en: The car headlights were almost blinding on the dark country road.
examples.zh: 黑暗的乡间路上,车灯晃得人几乎睁不开眼。

meaning: n. 绅士

examples.en: An elderly gent held the door open for us.
examples.zh: 一位老先生为我们扶住了门。

meaning: v. 延长, 加长( elongate的过去式和过去分词 )

examples.en: The designer used elongated mirrors to make the hallway look bigger.
examples.zh: 设计师用细长的镜子让走廊显得更宽敞。

meaning: a. 学校的, 学校教育的, 学者的, 学究的;n. 经院哲学家, 学究, 墨守成规者, 学生

examples.en: Her scholastic achievements earned her a place at a top university.
examples.zh: 她的学业成绩让她进入了顶尖大学。

meaning: a. 急流的；旺盛的

examples.en: Sorry I'm late; I was rushing between meetings all morning.
examples.zh: 抱歉迟到了,我一早上都在会议之间奔波。

meaning: n. 缓和, 减轻;减, 减轻, 缓和

examples.en: The company planted trees as mitigation for its carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 公司以植树来弥补自身的碳排放。

meaning: a. 可耻的, 不名誉的

examples.en: The way the staff were treated was absolutely disgraceful.
examples.zh: 员工受到的对待简直太不像话了。

meaning: 探求

examples.en: The reporter asked some probing questions about the missing funds.
examples.zh: 记者就失踪的资金提出了几个尖锐问题。

meaning: n. 一种油、醋、盐、香料等合成的浓烈调味品

examples.en: Toss the salad with a simple lemon vinaigrette before serving.
examples.zh: 上桌前用简单的柠檬油醋汁拌一下沙拉。

meaning: adv. 非常不幸地, 可悲地, 贫困地

examples.en: Our team failed miserably in the second half of the match.
examples.zh: 我们队在下半场输得一败涂地。

meaning: v. 用力咀嚼, 大声咀嚼

examples.en: The rabbits munch on fresh lettuce every single morning.
examples.zh: 兔子每天早上都大口吃着新鲜生菜。

meaning: n. 以恐怖反恐怖主义, 报复性恐怖主义

examples.en: He joined a counterterrorism unit after ten years in the army.
examples.zh: 他在陆军服役十年后加入了反恐部队。

meaning: n. 卡巴莱(有歌舞表演的餐馆或夜总会), 卡巴莱歌舞表演

examples.en: We spent the evening at a smoky cabaret in Paris.
examples.zh: 我们在巴黎一家烟雾缭绕的歌舞厅度过了一晚。

meaning: a. 辅助军事的

examples.en: The border was patrolled by an armed paramilitary group.
examples.zh: 边境由一支武装的准军事组织巡逻。

meaning: weave的过去分词

examples.en: Her grandmother gave her a woven basket full of apples.
examples.zh: 奶奶送给她一个装满苹果的编织篮。

meaning: n. 军舰, 战船

examples.en: A grey warship appeared on the horizon at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,一艘灰色军舰出现在地平线上。

meaning: n. 束腰外衣;膜, 被膜

examples.en: She wore a simple cotton tunic over her swimsuit.
examples.zh: 她在泳衣外面穿了一件棉质短袍。

meaning: a. 不可否认的

examples.en: Her talent for music is undeniable, even to harsh critics.
examples.zh: 即使最苛刻的评论家也不否认她的音乐天赋。

meaning: v. (使)得到休养, (使)得到娱乐, 再创造

examples.en: The museum tried to recreate the atmosphere of a 1900s street.
examples.zh: 博物馆力图重现二十世纪初街道的氛围。

meaning: n. 行程安排, 时间表制定;调度

examples.en: Scheduling meetings across three time zones is a real headache.
examples.zh: 在三个时区之间安排会议真让人头疼。

meaning: a. 无生命的, 无趣味的, 死气沉沉的

examples.en: The plant looked lifeless until we moved it into the sun.
examples.zh: 那盆植物原本毫无生气,直到我们把它移到阳光下。

meaning: n. 军人, 维修人员;机械师; 维修人员

examples.en: Her father was a serviceman who served abroad for many years.
examples.zh: 她父亲是一名军人,在海外服役多年。

meaning: a. 不含糊的, 明确的;清晰的, 明白的, 不模糊的

examples.en: The manager gave an unambiguous instruction: finish the report today.
examples.zh: 经理下了明确的指示:今天必须完成报告。

meaning: n. 专业化, 特殊化, 专门化;特殊化, 专门化

examples.en: His specialization in heart surgery took over a decade of training.
examples.zh: 他专攻心脏外科,接受了十多年的训练。

meaning: n. 整理, 修剪, 装饰, 点缀物, 装饰物, 修剪下来的东西, 诈骗, 击败, 殴打;微调

examples.en: Grandpa spent the afternoon trimming the hedge in the garden.
examples.zh: 爷爷花了一下午修剪花园里的树篱。

meaning: n. <<可兰经>>

examples.en: He borrowed an English translation of the Koran from the library.
examples.zh: 他从图书馆借了一本英文版《古兰经》。

meaning: n. 铬, 铬合金;铬(24号元素)

examples.en: The old motorbike still has shiny chrome handles.
examples.zh: 这辆旧摩托车的镀铬把手依然闪亮。

meaning: n. 痒, 渴望, 疥疮;vi. 发痒, 渴望

examples.en: The wool sweater always gives me an itch on my neck.
examples.zh: 这件羊毛衫总让我的脖子发痒。

meaning: v. 辩护( defend的现在分词 ); 保卫; （足球、曲棍球等）防守; 进行辩护

examples.en: The defending champion lost in the first round of the tournament.
examples.zh: 卫冕冠军在锦标赛首轮就出局了。

meaning: n. 服务商；促进者

examples.en: A good facilitator keeps the meeting focused and on time.
examples.zh: 好的主持人能让会议保持专注并按时进行。

meaning: a. 优先的, (关税等)优惠的;特惠的; 特惠关税率, 优先权

examples.en: Members get preferential seating at every concert this season.
examples.zh: 会员在本季每场音乐会都能获得优先座位。

meaning: adv. 人种上, 民族上

examples.en: The neighborhood is ethnically diverse, with families from six continents.
examples.zh: 这个社区族裔多元,住着来自六大洲的家庭。

meaning: n. 移民, 移居外国(或外地);血细胞渗出

examples.en: The museum tells the story of mass emigration in the 1800s.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲述了十九世纪大规模移民海外的历史。

meaning: a. 逻辑的; 后勤方面的

examples.en: Moving a whole office abroad is a huge logistical challenge.
examples.zh: 把整个办公室搬到国外在后勤上是巨大的挑战。

meaning: n. 副本, 复制;重迭, 双折, 复制

examples.en: The new system avoids duplication of patient records across hospitals.
examples.zh: 新系统避免了病历在各医院之间的重复。

meaning: n. 砖建筑物, 砌砖;砌砖工作

examples.en: The old pub has beautiful red brickwork outside.
examples.zh: 这家老酒馆的外墙是漂亮的红砖结构。

meaning: n. 抽水, 泵送;抽运

examples.en: Firefighters spent hours pumping water out of the flooded basement.
examples.zh: 消防员花了几个小时把水从被淹的地下室抽出来。

meaning: n. 水仙花;a. 水仙花色的

examples.en: A yellow daffodil bloomed beside the garden gate in March.
examples.zh: 三月,花园门旁开了一朵黄水仙。

meaning: adv. 不合理地

examples.en: The landlord's unreasonably high rent increase forced them to move.
examples.zh: 房东离谱的涨租逼得他们搬了家。

meaning: n. 耶稣会信徒, 阴险的人, 阴谋家

examples.en: The old university was founded by a Jesuit priest in 1540.
examples.zh: 这所古老的大学由一位耶稣会神父创立于1540年。

meaning: n. 蓄意破坏者

examples.en: A vandal smashed the bus shelter glass over the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末有破坏者打碎了公交候车亭的玻璃。

meaning: n. 怀疑论者

examples.en: I was a sceptic about yoga until I tried it.
examples.zh: 在亲自尝试之前,我对瑜伽一直持怀疑态度。

meaning: n. 伊顿公学

examples.en: He won a scholarship to study at Eton as a teenager.
examples.zh: 他少年时获得了去伊顿公学读书的奖学金。

meaning: n. 尼罗河

examples.en: We took a boat trip down the Nile at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落时我们乘船沿尼罗河游览。

meaning: n. 二轮战车

examples.en: The museum displays a bronze chariot used in ancient battles.
examples.zh: 博物馆展出了一辆古代作战用的青铜战车。

meaning: n. 全盛时期, 夏季

examples.en: In summertime the children play outside until it gets dark.
examples.zh: 夏天孩子们在外面一直玩到天黑。

meaning: n. 烟灰缸

examples.en: He kept an old glass ashtray on the garage workbench.
examples.zh: 他在车库工作台上放着一个旧玻璃烟灰缸。

meaning: n. 司机

examples.en: A uniformed chauffeur opened the door of the black car.
examples.zh: 一位穿制服的司机拉开了黑色汽车的车门。

meaning: vt. 撬, 撬开, 撬动

examples.en: I had to prise the window open with a screwdriver.
examples.zh: 我不得不用螺丝刀撬开窗户。

meaning: n. 街头的边石;路边

examples.en: She parked the car slightly too far from the kerb.
examples.zh: 她停的车离路缘石稍微远了点。

meaning: a. 镀金的, 有钱的, 装饰的;gild的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: The palace ballroom has gilded ceilings and huge crystal chandeliers.
examples.zh: 宫殿舞厅有镀金的天花板和巨大的水晶吊灯。

meaning: a. 无缝的, 无缝合线的;无缝的

examples.en: The app makes booking tickets a completely seamless experience.
examples.zh: 这款应用让购票体验非常顺畅。

meaning: n. 政体, 国体, 政治组织;政府, 政治制度, 政治形态

examples.en: Ancient Athens is often described as the first democratic polity.
examples.zh: 古雅典常被描述为第一个民主政体。

meaning: n. 投机者, 投机商人, 思索者;投机买卖者, 投机商

examples.en: A property speculator bought the old theatre at auction.
examples.zh: 一名房地产投机商在拍卖会上买下了那家老剧院。

meaning: n. 罂粟;罂粟

examples.en: Red poppy flowers covered the field behind our house.
examples.zh: 红色的罂粟花开满了我们家后面的田野。

meaning: a. 神话的, 存在于神话中的, 神话式的, 不真实的, 虚构的, 幻想出来的

examples.en: The city of Atlantis has a mythic quality in many legends.
examples.zh: 亚特兰蒂斯城在许多传说中带有神话色彩。

meaning: a. 表面上的;n. 外观

examples.en: Despite his seeming calm, he was extremely nervous before the exam.
examples.zh: 尽管表面看似平静,他考前其实非常紧张。

meaning: n. 葡萄轴

examples.en: She cut a grapefruit in half for breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上她把一个西柚切成两半当早餐。

meaning: n. 性别歧视, 歧视女性

examples.en: The company introduced new rules to fight sexism at work.
examples.zh: 公司出台了新规定来对抗职场性别歧视。

meaning: n. 朝鲜蓟;朝鲜蓟

examples.en: We shared a steamed artichoke with lemon butter at dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐我们分享了一只配柠檬黄油的蒸洋蓟。

meaning: n. 唤醒, 觉醒, 被唤起;a. 觉醒中的

examples.en: Her trip to the mountains sparked a spiritual awakening.
examples.zh: 山区之行引发了她的心灵觉醒。

meaning: a. 戴假面具的, 隐现的, 伪装的;掩蔽的, 隐蔽的

examples.en: Masked dancers performed in the square during the spring festival.
examples.zh: 春节期间广场上有蒙面舞者表演。

meaning: a. 有精神的, 活泼的, 生气勃勃的

examples.en: The debate became quite spirited as both sides defended their views.
examples.zh: 随着双方各自坚持立场,辩论变得相当激烈。

meaning: a. 伊莉莎白一世时代的, 伊莉莎白女王的;n. 伊莉莎白王朝时的人

examples.en: We watched a play in a reconstruction of an Elizabethan theatre.
examples.zh: 我们在复建的伊丽莎白时代剧场里看了一场戏。

meaning: n. 锻工

examples.en: She gets off the tube at Hammersmith every weekday morning.
examples.zh: 每个工作日早上她都在哈默史密斯下地铁。

meaning: n. 六便士硬币, 六便士

examples.en: Granddad kept an old silver sixpence from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 爷爷保存着一枚二十世纪五十年代的六便士银币。

meaning: n. 村庄；小乡镇（等于thorp）

examples.en: We spent the day at Thorpe Park with the kids.
examples.zh: 我们和孩子们在索普公园玩了一天。

meaning: a. 配备的, 放在合适地位的;拟定的

examples.en: The carpenter fitted new shelves in the living room.
